title: Welcome to the Nightmare Live
description: Wen Jianyan was a fraudster that was best at deceiving people. One day, he was suddenly forced to become a novice anchor in the Nightmare live broadcast room. Wen Jianyan: “…..” A newcomer became the most-watched anchor because he was too good at deceiving people. He lied to his teammates to deceive the audience and NPCs. He could deceive people as well as ghosts. Sooner or later this guy will overturn! There were more and more spectators who were gloating with schadenfreude, looking forward for that day. But…why was the mission in this live room getting more and more strange? 【Senior anchor’s side quest: Kiss the evil spirit for 30 seconds】 【Reward: Unknown】 【Top anchor’s main quest: Undress the evil god for three minutes】 【Reward: Unknown】 Audience: Oh, the streamer has mastered a new wealth code? Hurry up, there’s something our paying viewers can’t watch! The top boss approached step by step, whispering temptations: “How is it? Frying CP*? We can make the fake thing real.” Wen Jianyan: “…..” I’m sorry, I’m very principled, thank you for not deceiving yourself. — Don’t come here! *Frying CP means pretending to be a couple.

title: Pure White Devil
description: With one eye shut and one eye open, he seems to be officially demented. He remembers not his name, but has a vague recollection of the buddy he made a living with — a miraculous left eye. Just by looking at a corpse, the eye could determine its cause of death and its killer (if one exists, that is). Great, he can become “Holmes 2.0”, “Poirot’s Godson”, or “Conan’s Brother”…… He might as well visit the police station and take the civil service exam. But who would have thought the world to change so fast, in the blink of an eye, mu*der was no longer a crime. The “law” had long since departed the world once upon a Halloween over five hundred years ago. The future generation referred to that day as “End of the World”. Of course, humans are always exaggerating. The world was fine, there was no destruction, all that’s destroyed was just the society of mankind. Loud singing befits the dark alley. Revelry belongs in the depth of hell. Amidst the vast wilderness, must exist a Kindler. When all have settled to dust, I will be the King of the world. ————– Prologue of the “Song of the Exile” serialization

Guide Gong: Got reborn more than once? Sentinel Shou: This is my third life, I didn’t expect to be reborn again, and I also didn’t expect to meet you, so fortuned—— Guide Gong: Met me, so what? description: Li Shuoxing, the god author of the male channel, got a love nurturing app out of thin air in his phone. title: Bu Tian Gang
description: After finally being admitted to the Department of Exorcism, Dong Zhi’s dream was to grasp both work and love as he strived to pursue an icy male god, igniting an intense love affair. A train bound for spring was the beginning of everything. The mountains were solitary, blanketed with snow, as smoke began dissipating. In the brilliant morning rays, Dong Zhi’s gaze fell on Long Shen’s back. Hidden deep within his eyes, he held countless words for him. “To you, whom I love dearly with all my heart, my time in this life, I’ll offer them to you.”

title: How to Feed an Abyss!
description: 【if you stare into the abyss, the abyss stares back at you】 The abyss, the most feared thing by the human race today. The animals infected by the abyss mutate into monsters, and humans are reduced to walking corpses. Lu Tinghan is an abyss watcher. He has been guarding the world’s most terrifying abyss for ten years. This abyss is not only scary, but also strange. Throw the garbage down, after a few days, the garbage will be buried safely next to the abyss – like someone took a shovel and tossed it all night to bury them. Throw hazardous waste down, after a few days, the waste will be thrown back with unbridled fury. Lu Tinghan: ? Ten years later, he left the post and became the youngest general in the Alliance. The next day, the abyss was also gone. ——The whole thing disappeared and turned into flat land. The whole world was shocked. Until one day, there was a knock on Lu Tinghan’s door. A boy with little devil horns stood outside the door, with delicate features and bright eyes. Obviously, he was scared to death, but he still plucked up the courage to say: “Hello, I, I am Abyss, can you continue to stare at me? QAQ” He added: “I have helped you bury the garbage every day, oh!” During their long time together, Lu Tinghan learned two things: 1. Staring at your abyss every day, the abyss will be happy 2. When the abyss is happy, it will purr toward you

Communications were interrupted, water and electricity support ceased, chemical plant leaked, nuclear power plant exploded, the world was reduced to be like hell on earth; without God, it became an era of legends and saviors, with the fire of survival instinct rekindled within mortals. title: Became A God In An Eerie Realm After Hearing Players’ Inner Voices
description: Cen Xun is a folklore professor at H University—beautiful, young, and captivating countless students in every class. His life follows a monotonous routine, calm and uneventful, until an unexpected fall from a building. After resurrecting, Cen Xun suddenly discovers the secrets of this world. For example, his life is actually repeating in a daily cycle: his husband prepares breakfast on time, drops him off at the university precisely on schedule, and in the evening, their time spent in intimacy is accurate to the second. For example, he can hear the thoughts of those around him and learns that a group of individuals calling themselves “players” has infiltrated his students. “Awooo! Our professor is just too stunning—third time checking in! Gotta take a selfie!” “I can’t bear to part with our gorgeous professor. It’s rare for the dog game to have such a beautiful model, but sadly, H University is about to become a B-rank Eerie Domain. The professor isn’t a main character, so he’ll probably be cannon fodder in the end, wuwuwu.” Cen Xun sneered. Cannon Fodder? Impossible. At last, his dull life encounters a ripple. Amused by his own dark sense of humor, Cen Xun decides—why not stir the waters even more? Pre-Reading Guide: 1. The shou belongs to the antagonist faction, with questionable morals—don’t enter if you dislike. 2. Age gap (younger gong × older shou). 3. Non-human. The shou is not human. 4. Over-the-top shuangwen. The couple has a love-hate relationship script, and the hate is rather intense (but the love is also super strong).

title: Rise of the Othergod Apostle: Not a Cult Leader, but a Serf?!
description: Ah, why did I waste my life on this game? Why didn’t I actually quit when I kept saying I would, day after day, because the game was so frustrating? Is this my punishment for playing it? I was a veteran player of [Conclude: Rise of the Othergod Apostle] . I quit because I was fed up with other players, but I still had lingering regrets for [Hapenesus] a God I couldn’t clear no matter what. Then, an update notification for [Conclude] popped up. Hoping this might be my chance to finally clear [Hapenesus] , I logged back in. Hapenesus: My evangelist. Hapenesus: You are the first of your kind. SYSTEM: ‘Hapenesus’ grants you a hidden trait. SYSTEM: Amazing achievement! You have charmed an ‘Othergod’ with just a conversation! My excitement about possibly being the first to clear ‘Hapenesus’ was short-lived. Mother Aelusia: My beloved child. Mother Aelusia: No matter who you choose, I will find you. Mother Aelusia: And I will be with you. “No, what is this? Why is it suddenly turning into a horror story?” SYSTEM: “Mother Aelusia’’ is forcibly summoning you to the Dark Realm. …And just like that, I found myself pulled into a game where I was supposed to be a apostle of a cult religion. But surprisingly, the biggest problem wasn’t that. Happy War Evangelist (???): Serf “Wait, I’m… a serf?” ** A serf is a lower social class who works on the land owned by lords in exchange for a small amount of produce. *Edited on 2025

title: Director of a Suspense Film
description: The dead broke small streamer Zong Qi received a random message one day. That night, he got pulled onto the set of a horror film and was informed that if he didn’t shoot it… He’ll die. He was lucky that the actors were all working as hard as they could, and the director only needed to stand around and watch the show. But because he had been given way too much, Zong Qi didn’t hesitate at all before making his own changes. Under his false identity was an ‘evil mastermind’ that fought with the actors on everything. The immoral things he’s done on set include but aren’t limited to– Personally putting makeup on the ghost, teaching actors how to mess and change the script, exposing himself at crucial times… People as arrogant as him usually don’t have good endings when their identities were revealed. What Zong Qi didn’t expect was that instead of the actors joining up for revenge, an unlucky bastard’s whose plans had been spoilt by him countless times appeared instead. The man took off his glasses, revealing a pair of closed eyes, his face beautiful and cold. The brush dipped in paint hooked past the young man’s neck, full of danger. “You dirtied my brush.” He smirked, drawling, “As punishment, I’ll dirty you.”

title: I Rely On Poverty To Sweep Through Survival Games
description: Xiao Lan was a pauper who couldn’t do anything that required money. On the road after work, he was engulfed by darkness and opened his eyes to a frightening and dangerous survival game. The app that can’t be deleted; the people it locked on to were unable to escape except through death. Ordinary players: Save me, I don’t want to die!!! Xiao Lan: Sorry, the phone is too broken and it froze. Can you wait a little longer? A hand reached out from inside an old-fashioned television; the people caught would enter its world. Ordinary players: Ahhhhhhh! What to do?! Xiao Lan: According to my many years of experience repairing old household appliances, it seems that this model can be opened like this… Finally, the bosses gathered around Xiao Lan one day, prepared to deal with this (game) bug. But they saw him roll up his sleeves and stride forward on long legs, and he beat up the bosses until they doubted their ghostly births. Xiao Lan: Do you think an overtime worker’s night travels are for nothing? Luo: Sir is always this cute. Passer-by (shivering): Isn’t your definition of cute a little strange…

description: Theatrical regression life of an old-fashioned villain who recalled his past life. “There’s nothing I wouldn’t do for a better life.” —— Survival in the ‘Otherworld’; a place where only the insane can set foot in.

title: The Yin-Yang Sage
description: A story about a fraudster who makes a living by deceiving others, meeting a real Taoist priest. Modern urban setting, involving all walks of life, feng shui, Taoist rituals, and supernatural phenomena. Taoist priest gong x fraudster shou, childhood acquaintances turned strangers, manly gay couple, 1v1.

title: Did You See My Cat?
description: Yan Jiyun died surprisingly, and what was even more surprising was that he was reborn in the body of a cat after his death. He thought he would live out his whole life in a cat shell, and his master would care for him until he died. His owner Qi Feng was a weird person. He would often disappear from the house from time to time and would suddenly reappear after a few days. During that period, he would be covered in injuries or suffering from abnormal fatigue. Then one day, Yan Jiyun accidentally touched the nameplate that Qi Feng had always kept with him, and he was suddenly brought into a strange world. No matter how strange and dangerous that world was, Yan Jiyun discovered that he could become a human again in this world! ◆Yan Jiyun (shou) X Qi Feng (gong). The story is a plotty unlimited flow, not a pure romance. It’s quite long, with a lot of emotional drama.
