title: Haunted Places Live
description: What’s it like to be a camera assistant for a supernatural live-streaming celebrity who makes a career out of death? Chu Yang answers: Who am I? Where am I? Chu Yang was just an ordinary hotel room attendant, he never expected that he would be dragged into a world of weirdness and wonder after encountering a narcissistic and dramatic live-streaming celebrity. Ghostly shadows in the hotel, decaying and deformed patients in a hospital, suicidal spirits in a boarding school, the crying of babies in a department store at night and a ghostly deer outside the forest cabin…… had turned his world view upside down. From then on, seeing ghosts and fighting monsters became commonplace, and more often than not he had to face the maddening horror of the unknown. Cthulhu inspired, also influenced and inspired by Silent Hill, The Shining, Graveyard Encounter, Rick and Morty, Layers of Fear, Biocentri□□□, etc.

title: When Youth Fails to See the Demon Lord’s Greatness
description: Feng Qingyun waited for his Senior Brother for more than a lifetime, from being young and enthusiastic to having his sincere heart replaced with ashes. While his Senior Brother won praise and followers everywhere, becoming the leader of the Righteous Path, he was nothing but a dried speckle of mosquito blood- dismissed and forgotten. But then the sky collapsed, and the whole cultivation world turned to chaos. After using all his spiritual power to send his disciples to safety, Feng Qingyun had no choice but to wait for death, trapped in a cave with his mortal enemy… The Demon Lord, who came to mock his final moments. “Little Palace Master,  your husband is probably crying in the arms of some beauty right now, swearing to look for you in his next life, while you can only die in here with me. Giving your heart to the wrong man, do you regret it?” Hearing his mockery, Feng Qingyun fell silent. Facing that cold expression until the sky collapsed over his body, the Demon Lord changed his tone and said lightly:” If I knew you’d turn up like this because of that fool, I wouldn’t have hesitated on your wedding day.” “…?!” When he opened his eyes again, Feng Qingyun returned to the night before he became his Senior Brother’s Dao companion. “Your Excellency, you were not invited,” he said calmly, walking thowards an ordinary looking cultivator. “What’s the point of coming all the way here?” The other party was silent before removing his disguise. And just like that, the demon feared by the entire cultivation world looked at Feng Qingyun with a hint of mischief before saying: “I am here to get back what already belongs to me.” “And what is that?” “You.” ………… Double rebirth, but the gong doesn’t remember in the beginning. The flower demon turned sword cultivator who hasn’t bloomed in six hundred years vs. The Lord of the demon race who loves to tease his wife and pretend to be cool
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Follow the Sheep into the Abyss
description: Due to a friend’s betrayal, Yang Yohan ends up in the worst dungeon of all, the Abyss. In this monster-infested dungeon, Yohan encounters Lee Hyunmook, once considered the strongest Awakened in Korea, who had gone missing in the Abyss years ago. “Mr. Lee Hyunmook, please don’t kill me, okay? I’m human…” “Human…” “Yes, I’m human… and so are you, Mr. Lee Hyunmook.” However, Lee Hyunmuk has been half-driven mad by the influence of the Abyss. Yohan struggles to survive alongside him, tending to wounds and foraging for food, during the rare moments when Hyunmook regains his sanity. “Every few decades, a certain phenomenon occurs here. And I call it a ‘Flood.’” “A Flood?” “The closer the Flood gets, the worse the contamination and madness become… just like how I was moments ago.” But when an unexpected Flood strikes, Hyunmook loses his mind completely… “You’re a sheep, so why don’t you cry?” “I-I’m not a sheep, I’m Yang Yohan…” “My little sheep.” A brutal environment, a festering wound on one leg, terrifying monsters howling as they attack, and now the erratic behavior of a deranged Hyunmook… Thus begins Yohan’s tear-filled escape from another world!
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Replacing the Evil Way
description: He Wei took over a mu*der case in an abandoned mansion, and the deceased Cheng Zesheng, Male, a pianist, was killed by gunshot. At the same time, in the same mansion, Cheng Zesheng was leading a team to inspect the scene. The deceased, He Wei, male, a company employee, died of suffocation. Different worlds, and different professions, the only thing in common was that they had died in each other’s world. What was it that connected the protagonists of the mu*der investigation in the two parallel worlds? With the collision of time and space, the two parallel spaces had quietly changed. He Wei gradually found that this was an unsolvable situation. Struggling in the cycle of fate, how could Cheng Zesheng be saved? Without meeting, there would be no beginning. When the clock strikes zero, would he still stand the opposite?
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Bermuda
description: Leonardo Blaine, the true war hero of the Raina Logia Empire and the commander of the Armsilver 11th Squad, is dishonorably discharged for disobeying orders during the final battle that could have led the Empire to victory in the territorial war. People criticize and point fingers at him, and after being released on parole from prison, he disappears without a trace. Three years later, his name has been forgotten by the world. The Council has been persistently pursuing him, but he has proven difficult to capture. Frustrated by this, Hugo Agrizendro, the commander of the Council’s army, decides to personally apprehend him. “Since when have you been watching me?” Leonardo was calculative and astute, so it wouldn’t be surprising if he had been observing Hugo for some time now. However, Leonardo’s answer was something that even Hugo had not anticipated. “From the very beginning.”
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Don’t Be a Kept Man
description: In this world, there is always one type of man who does not want to improve themselves. They care only for themselves, by whatever means possible. They make their life goal to be kept as a lover, and they will use their lovers up until they have no more use. Self-Reliant System: Our goal is to rise up! Our goal is to persevere! We must be self-sufficient and self-reliant! When the system has bound numerous souls to enter into the bodies of those who only rely on their lovers, what could this lead to? In other words, this is the main character transmigrating into a scummy human being, and creating his own destiny kind of story.

title: The Entire City Is My Husband
description:
They had grown up together and gotten married, but Xie Shiyu had unfortunately passed away in a plane crash. Chu Feng couldn’t accept this fate and thus chose to find solace like this. The system extracted countless versions of Xie Shiyu from his memory and created Chu Feng’s Dream City from it. “Chu Feng gege, I want a hug!” A 5-year-old Shiyu ran into his embrace. “Where’s my good morning kiss today, Professor Chu?” An 18-year-old school tyrant wrapped his arm around Chu Feng’s shoulder. “Let’s do it in my office later,” A 25-year-old President Xie wrapped his arm around his waist. Chu Feng was very happy playing with the entire city of Xie Shiyus and thus lived happily ever after. —That is, if you ignore the pain in his waist every night. However, there was a curse in this happy Dream City. The Xie Shiyus in his Dream City would also experience a terrible fate of death, whether it was the bus exploding, the playground catching fire, or the bridge cracking in half… What was supposed to be a sweet couple game instantly turned into a survival game. Chu Feng could only request the game to assign him a guardian for protection after that. As a result, the system gave him the highest-ranked S guardian, X, to protect him. It sounded very reassuring indeed. But not long after, Chu Feng found that the S-ranked Guardian was a little over the top. He would hold his hand while disarming the bomb, grab his waist when jumping into the ocean, and princess carry him when walking out of a fire. There was even an instance where he brought Chu Feng to the 108th floor of the hotel to stargaze. Chu Feng: I’m sorry but I’m taken. I have a boyfriend.
Guardian X: That’s not what the files in the system said.
Chu Feng: What does it say?
Guardian X: Widowed, depressed, and looking for love.
Chu Feng: …

title: Even the Villain Has a Story
description: One day, the gates opened, and the world was thrown into chaos. At the same time, Sayun was confronted by a strange System Window. Forced into the role of a villain and slowly losing his mind, Sayun seizes upon a single clue to escape the damned System: he kidnaps Han Geonju. “…What do you want from me?” “Talent acquisition?” “You kidnap people for that? What are you, some mafia guild?” The System’s clue to escape lies in a disposition: The One Who Resists. To activate it, Sayun decides to raise Geonju to S-rank and stay close to him. He pampers him endlessly, calling him pretty, nurturing him with care, only for Geonju to disappear without a word just as he was on the verge of becoming an S-ranker. Eventually, Geonju returns… now as a full-fledged S-rank Hunter, standing before Sayun once more. “What the f*ck are you playing at?” “Do you like throwing people away like tr*sh?” Who was the one who abandoned whom first? “If you want to know what it feels like to crawl on all fours, go ahead and try running again.” A perilous reunion. Ominous signs from the gates. Will Sayun ever break free from the System?

title: Shizun
description:
Otherwise known as:
Master’s Favorite Hobby Is Standing on the Precipice of Exhilarating Danger and Hopping Up and Down
The Repentance of an Evil Disciple: My Master Was too Delicious Ten thousand years ago, there was once a sword cultivator named Lord Yunzhen. He caught hold of a little sword spirit with outstanding talent. Filled with joy, he became a master for the first time, assiduously raising his disciple. He could be called the very model of the profession, so dedicated that it was a little weird. His disciple found his master so sweet and delicious that his heart turned black, and he became the lord of all demons. *** The process: all sorts of exhilarating thrills that can’t be described in Jinjiang Literature City. The result: My account got deleted, and I had to start over. *** Ten thousand years later, Lu Yunzhen was a broke college student studying computer science. He met a terrifying high-level demon with outstanding talent, who wanted to take him as a master, and wouldn’t take no for an answer. Mo Changkong acted honest. “I have pure intentions.”
Mo Changkong swore, “I’ll listen to everything you say.”
Mo Changkong was a practiced salesman. “I can slay monsters and demons.”
Mo Changkong guaranteed, “I’d never lust after Master’s beauty.” Lu Yunzhen believed him! Then one day, he recovered his memories, and realized his disciple wasn’t a loyal hound, but a possessive freak. Lu Yunzhen: “???” Mo Changkong: “Sorry, no returns allowed.” *** This is the story of a loving master and loyal disciple, who stay that way so long as they’re not in bed. They fight monsters shoulder to shoulder, protect the public, and become heroes of the nation. In bed, well, that’s a different story—pillows and sheets go flying, and they quarrel as lovers do. Lu Yunzhen: I love the world, it’s happy endings no matter where you go. Mo Changkong: Master and I are the world.

title: Encountering a Snake
description: Getting drenched by a hot cup of tea is like emptying a basin of dog’s blood over your head. The snake demon could not remain calm, and discovered after biting back that, it actually did not matter if he bit him or not. This person—was going to die anyways. A touching story between a mortal and a snake demon that started because of a hot cup of tea. And their entanglement that lasted three lifetimes.

title: Ghost Says
description: After attending the funeral of his high school classmate, Song Yuan, Qiao Gang’s world undergoes a drastic change – His arguing colleague, his best friend and roommate, his girlfriend, all die mysteriously. To cooperate with the police investigation, Qiao Gang starts living together with the case officer, Lin Xian, and they gradually develop ambiguous feelings. As the two gradually approach the bizarre truth, all the clues of the mu*ders point to the deceased, Song Yuan! They have to face the cruel fact that Song Yuan’s twisted love, in the end, who is he going to hurt? Right and wrong, justice and injustice in this are an unsolvable mystery, persistence, jealousy, possessiveness…everyone has a terrifying demon of love in their hearts, it’s just always waiting for the right time to awaken.

title: Ghost Marriage
description: White things are sorrowful, red things are joyful, I shall pass from the mortal realm to the underworld, Joss candles, paper horses, sedan chair, Meng Po bears witness to our union, White paper and red robes, the suona sounds for tens of miles—together in life, and together in death.

title: Today, This Bystander Passed by the Male Lead’s Set Again
description: In China, there’s a tumultuous five-member boy band known as ABCDE. Except for the utterly unremarkable protagonist E of this story, the other members are all configured as typical JJ male leads. – A is a reborn individual who was switched at birth. In his past life, he was used as a stand-in by a CEO. His life is filled with complex male-male relationships, daily entangled in various Asura fields and “chasing wife in the crematorium” scenarios. – B is a top scorer in the college entrance examination, actually a big shot from ancient times who transmigrated to the present. He’s proficient in various traditional arts and painting; his works are hailed as national treasures. – C is a superpowered individual who fast-travels through dreams to the movies he needs to act in. He’s praised as a genius of experiential acting. – D is an infinite flow player who frequently disappears for ten minutes during events to clear dungeons, earning a reputation for poor kidney function and being haunted by supernatural events. He’s famous in the industry for his extreme sports skills. Only our protagonist E lacks any superpowers or melodramatic plots in this vibrant boy band, yet he is often inadvertently drawn into the colorful lives of ABCD. For instance: – When a group of CEOs is attempting to “chase wives in the crematorium,” E casually walks by while playing on his phone and says, “Please line up today as well.” – When B is performing mental arithmetic of four-digit numbers multiplied by four-digit numbers, E stands beside him using a calculator on his phone, saying, “Oh, so that’s how it is.” – When C accidentally reveals he’s been traversing through movies and nervously looks at E, E tilts his head but neither confirms nor denies noticing. And when C complains about the high challenge of a scene, E, still playing on his phone, says, “But if it’s you, C, there must be a way.” – Occasionally, upon entering the restroom and coming face-to-face with D—who has suddenly appeared, covered in blood and looking at himself in horror—E calmly says, “There are still twenty minutes before we go on stage. Is that enough time to clean your face?” E believes he’s living a peaceful life, but his four teammates feel he sees through everything and find him terrifying. On the second anniversary of the band’s formation, ABCDE accepts an interview. Reporter: Among the five of you, there’s A, the center of tumultuous scandals; B, who casually produces national treasure-level paintings and might have to go home to inherit the family business if he doesn’t work hard; C, an experiential acting genius rare in a century; D, known for his mysterious aura and being haunted by supernatural events; and… E, who is often ridiculed for always playing on his phone, treating the industry like clocking in and out of work, and is as unremarkable as a passerby. Who do you think is the most unfathomable person? A: E B: E C: E D: E Reporter: …E, what do you think? E, who had been ignored by the reporter, looks up from his phone. “Ah, is it my turn? Hmm, I think everyone is just ordinary people who get along well.” ABCD: *(Looking at E’s gentle smile for the N+1th time)* E is terrifying!!!

title: After I Became the Youngest Son of a Lord [Western Fantasy]
description: One cold winter, the land of Francis, abandoned by the gods, welcomed the youngest and most beloved son of the lord and lady. The people of Francis expressed their gratitude to the brave lord and the kind lady by bringing out their finest foods and gathering around the bonfire to sing beautiful hymns. At that time, no one knew what astonishing changes this frail child would bring to this desolate land. Eli Curtis Francis, a five-year-old, whose soul is a computer science student from another world, stared thoughtfully at the cards drawn from his late-arriving card drawing system. While others summon forbidden beasts and legendary weapons, he draws potato and beet construction blueprints. Well, at least the system started him off with a dragon. Fine, while others are out hunting dragons and searching for treasure in a world of swords and magic, he’ll take up a shovel and focus on infrastructure. A quirky dwarf master shoulders his burdens and heads towards the continent’s first smelting base, an elf who shuns contact with humans holds a delicate bowl of ice cream in the marketplace, and a bard strums his harp on a towering city wall, singing loudly. Francis, the Land of Freedom Abandoned by the gods They are valiant and skilled in battle, they are rich and just Purple irises bloom on the endless ice plains The shadow of the dragon sweeps over every scorching land Francis, the Land of Freedom A place where the gods cannot reach It is magnificent and dazzling, gentle and inclusive Praise the Land of Freedom, Francis —————————————————— Pairing: Infrastructure-obsessed frail mage (uke) x ruthless, powerful, tragic half-elf (seme) The early relationship is very unpleasant There is the ‘wife-chasing crematorium’ trope and the ‘hungry wolf turned loyal dog’ trope, but in the later stages, the seme enters the scene rather late. In the eyes of the uke, magic is akin to a program, and the uke is the star of the computer science department. The uke begins by capturing a dragon, and there’s a special reason why he’s not suspected. The entire Holy Church is made up of villains. —————————————————— Francis does not believe in gods; we only believe in the hoes in our hands and the swords at our waists, the campfire before us and the magic we chant, the sunset over our land and the laughter we share with one another.

title: ERROR: Metamorphosis
description: A chilling new world unfolds in ERROR: Metamorphosis, an interconnected dungeon-crawling, monster-fighting, and puzzle-solving novel featuring Zhao Ran × Yu An. “Newcomers, remember: never offend Team Leader Zhao. Always follow his orders—no exceptions. Don’t act without his command, don’t try to outsmart him, and, above all, never, under any circumstances, touch his hand.” Yu An: “Got it.” (When danger strikes, grab the team leader’s hand and run.) —— Yu An wakes in a hospital, disoriented and haunted by missing memories. The sterile environment conceals lurking dangers—monsters called “Aberrants” that hunt innocent people. In this chaos, he meets Zhao Ran, a captivating pink-haired man who works for Underground Metro, an organization dedicated to hunting these creatures. As they grow closer, Yu An discovers his old journal entry about a mysterious man from his past, a figure who feels hauntingly familiar yet remains lost to him. This revelation intertwines his fate with Zhao Ran, igniting feelings that complicate their dangerous mission.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: After The Abyss Dragon Woke Up
description: Shi An is the last Abyss Dragon in the world. Since he was bored, he decided to go into a deep sleep while hugging his treasures. After fifty thousand years of satisfying slumber, Shi An opened his eyes only to discover that he had become a weak human with short hands and legs. He glanced down at his mysteriously downsized body and then lifted his head to look around his empty cave. “……” Where is my powerful and majestic body? My big tail? Most importantly, where are my treasures?! After thousands of years of hard work, sleeping just once has sent me to square one. *** In the year 2202, the conflicts between humans and monsters are becoming more and more intense. Although the monsters are strong, the fantastical species that used to rule the continent have all but disappeared. Shi An, the Shi family’s youngest son, is Mage Academy’s infamous mage who has no magic power. Each student’s magic power is measured at the beginning of the school year. Shi An looked at the three destroyed magic detection equipment and innocently asked, “Eh? Are these equipment’s quality not very good?” During actual combat training, low-ranked monsters fled before Shi An could get close. Shi An looked at their fleeing figures and innocently exclaimed, “Yay, lucky!” Everyone else was speechless. “……?” I believe I am dreaming. *** Mu Heng——human species’ strongest mage——is the only remaining human who bears the noble dragon slayer bloodline. He coldly and arrogantly said, “Dragons? Extinction is their best outcome.” A long time later, Mu Heng turned his head back to look at the dragon cub reclining on the piles of treasure. Mu Heng withdrew his gaze and leisurely asked, “Are there any other jobs? I want a well-paid one.” Extinction is out of the question now. As a matter of fact, I can only earn more money so that I won’t get kicked out of bed at night.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: One Silver Coin For a Pound of Demon
description: A priest was sold a mixed-blooded demon on his way home. It was cheap, so he bought it.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: After the Pirated Boss Returns to the Infinite Strange Tales
description:
Qi Jiu was killed on his eighteenth birthday. After his death, he entered the resurrection game “Rule Illustrated Handbook”. Other players struggled to survive, and corpses and bones were everywhere in the instance world. While newcomer Qi Jiu was trying to survive, he realized that things were becoming more and more out of place…… Former Employee of the Alienation Factory: “Boss, you blew up the factory. Can I get unemployment benefits?” Millennium Zombie in the Mass Grave: “Boss, you smashed my original coffin. Does this count as a work-related injury?” Ghost Bride of the Midnight Wedding: “Boss, you killed the ghost groom. Can I still get my 15 days of wedding leave granted? Or should I replace it with bereavement leave?” Qi Jiu: ?????
Why do you guys look so familiar with me? He seemed to possess some special ability, causing the monsters in the instances to address him as “Boss.” Until one day, he encountered the god-level boss 079 and discovered that this dangerous man had the exact same face as him… Qi Jiu panicked: Oh my. Turns out I’m pirated. * 079 was a legendary boss in the infinite world. With the strongest combat power and near-perfect face, players called him the unbeatable god of death. Many years ago, 079’s character data was stolen. The thief disappeared back to the real world and used 079’s data to clone an artificial human. Eighteen years later, in the terrifying world of infinite cycles, 079 met a special new player —— This person used a face that looked exactly like his to play his subordinates around and crashed all the instances. What should he do? It doesn’t matter, he’s super, super narcissistic anyway.

title: The Original Seeker
description: Bai Mo, you evil bastard! “Only the weakling will care about race and lineage, that’s because they need to see something that is similar to themselves to feel safe. And they need to use another life to continue their dreams; But the sun doesn’t need another sun, and the eternal one doesn’t need another to realize his own dreams.” A story of a lone seeker constantly searching for a way forward.

title: Folklore’s #1 Boss
description:
The third year spiritual energy was revived, humanity got swept into a real-life game of oddities, 《Folklore》.
The game randomly extracted from strange stories for its quests: If won, the quest’s boss would turn into a guardian deity, holding back all sorts of evils; If failed, the oddities would completely revive, and the area implicated in the quest would completely fall to enemy occupation! As it had impact,
The players participating in the quest and the stream audience hated idiots who were burdens the most. Unfortunately, when a disaster-level quest got unlocked, matched into the quest, was this,
Silver-grey long-haired, pessimistic, sickly, when others fought he slept, when others ran he showered
No matter how much more good-looking they were, it could not conceal that “I don’t want to live, everyone die with me” kind of anti-social air When his data was pulled up:
24k pure newbie. Everyone’s eyes went dark, GDI, this isn’t even enough for a bite for the boss! Yet no one knew, Wei E once was drawn into a different, much higher-dimension UF world
Over there, there would be a small quest every three days, and one big quest every five. Each quest would be stifled with a manic hopelessness, driving people to their deaths. No player was able to hang on for three years, and Wei E was the first who had a chance to live past three years—— after he bombed the Creator. When the Creator’s space was collapsing
Wei E reminisced these three years of endless fighting for his life, and strongly vowed: If there was a next life, he would definitely not get mixed in it again! Once Wei E opened his eyes, he returned to the familiar blue planet
But before he could get excited, he discovered…… the Creator followed him out too : )
—- That day the hunting grounds got destroyed, the Creator vowed there would be one day he would kill that insolent ant
When Wei E occasionally brushed his teeth and looked up, he could see the mirror written with: “After one hundred days, I will definitely kill you.” By the fiftieth day [left], a player confessed to Wei E.
By the thirtieth day, Wei E made it to first place in 《Folklore’s》most charming guy.
By the tenth day, the quest boss threw themselves on him.
By the fifth day, third day, each day, there would be people on the forums calling themselves Wei E’s dog. On the final day, the Creator really grabbed Wei E’s throat, with his voice dark and frenzied: “I said, I would kill you sooner or later.” However, seeing Wei E’s wearily curled lips, He thought, I perhaps should change the method.
For example, beneath his body.
———— When Wei E solved the first disaster-level quest, there were still people who felt it was a mere coincidence.
But when each and every one of the disaster-level continuously got cracked, life got brought back from death, they then shockingly discovered, that was not a coincidence, but hope that would make even spent clay revivify. And in this absurd, despairing world, he was the walking——
#1 boss!

title: The Blackened Villain Needs Me To Coax Him Again [Quick Transmigration]
description: Lin Yuan, who used to be a system, became a host and bound to the Villain Rescue System. In every world, he was working hard to save the villain. He was working very very very hard… The crazy CEO caressed Lin Yuan’s chin while the possessiveness in his eyes deepened: “ Lin Yuan, I’ll give you this life of mine okay?” The domineering classmate pressed him against the alley and confined his waist: “You were the one who approached me first, if you dare to leave me by even one step, I’ll break your leg so you can’t run away.” The aloof and venerable immortal master stepped down from the divine platform and said in a low voice: “Be obedient, Master will give you everything.” Other miserable hosts: Don’t come here! Lin Yuan chased to kiss: “I want more!  More kisses~”

title: Late Night Bar
description: A bar that doesn’t quite fit into the surroundings stood in the bustling downtown. It’s called Late Night Bar, but it’s only open during the day and has few customers. But in fact, the bar is very busy at night. The Empress, who has been in favor for ten years, sways her wine glass while teaching the delicate young master of the female-dominated world to compete for favor in a harem full of men. The omega who keeps gulping vodka hugs the little merman’s tail and refuses to let go, ranting about marrying the merman. The little priest of the primitive tribe, with a colorful c*cktail in hand, watches the agricultural channel on the tablet and firmly believes that this is a sacred temple. Jiang Qiubai, the owner of the bar, feels a throbbing headache upon seeing no normal person in the room. In fact, the only person who looks a little normal is supposed to be an ancient god. When he’s here, he never drinks, but only eats the fruit platter. His appetite is simply a bottomless pit. The price of fruits in the market almost inflated because of him. Jiang Qiubai feels that he has to negotiate with the god. “Dear God, you’ve eaten so many fruit platters in my bar. When are you going to pay the bill?” He’s still in debt worth tens of millions! Upper God Mo Ying, “Don’t all mortals want to live forever? I gave you an elixir ages ago. Isn’t it enough to offset the bill?” Jiang Qiubai is shocked. “What? An elixir of immortality? Wasn’t that Maltesers?” Mo Ying, “Do you think you can find chocolate in the celestial world?” Jiang Qiubai, “…” Well, chocolate doesn’t quite fit in the setting of the celestial world. But that Maltesers, no, that elixir of immortality has been eaten by his cat. What to do? Waiting online, quite urgent. Summary: I have drinks. Do you have a story? Moral of the Story: Finding your path in other people’s stories.

title: The Hero’s Coffin
description: “Meal time, prisoner number 444.” I found myself transmigrating into the body of a prisoner. A prisoner on death row who’s scheduled to die tomorrow. However, before I could even grasp the situation, the prison was broken into with a massive explosion and I was dragged outside. Now, I was officially an escaped convict. “Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Harenir von Lucette, leader of the Order of Sidon, the paladins that are tasked with defending the Holy Empire of Solares, and First Sword of the Order. And… I am the hero who is said to have died today.” His soft gaze, his gentle smile, and the benevolent yet watchful air he carried around him. Everything about him made him look like a saint. “I need the souls you command. Do you want to go back and die as a death row inmate, or will you help me and have your sentence reduced?” “Why do you need my help? Is there a reason it must be me? I’m sure there are other necromancers in the empire.” “Because you went around searching for as many corpses as you could, extracting their souls to use them as s*aves. You’re the only one ruthless enough to command human souls in the tens or hundreds.” After reluctantly accepting the quest, Isaf works in secret with the hero who antagonizes him to uncover the monsters’ secrets… “You… feel different from when we first met.” Will Isaf be able to gain this “freedom” in a game that has zero player welfare?

title: I Will Fulfill the Role of the Villain
description: The protagonist of a war fantasy novel, Theo, competes with his rival and antagonist, Luke, for the position of Supreme Commander. Having been reincarnated into Luke’s role, he struggles to fulfill his duties as the villain. “It seems like principles as a soldier, the duties I should uphold, don’t matter to you at all.” Even if misunderstood by Theo, Luke silently remained faithful to his role as the antagonist. After completing all his duties, Luke successfully gave Theo his happy ending, cast aside his military uniform, and retired from the army. Now, Luke planned to create his own future story without interference from anyone. That was the plan, at least… “Why go this far? I’m no longer a soldier, and if you really think about it, we were never on good terms anyway.” To make matters worse, not only had he unexpectedly reunited with Theo, but now, Theo was persistently and seriously pressing him in a way he hadn’t imagined. “I want to know you better.” It was a completely incomprehensible statement, and it wasn’t even an appropriate answer to the question. The protagonist came to the antagonist and suddenly asked for help, simply because they wanted to know him better?
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Running an Inn in the Deep Mountains of the Demon Realm
description: A self-made, money-obsessed bottom and a beautiful, elegant fox demon top. Nan Xu was struck by a small rock that fell from the sky and was dragged into the demon world. He was tied to a dilapidated inn deep in the mountains. Nan Xu picked up his iron axe and spent the day chopping down trees. Nan Xu stood at the doorway, smiling at the rock that had fallen on his head. “Welcome.” Nan Xu sat at the intersection and waited for days until a male fox spirit passed by. He rushed over and hugged his thigh. Get a cool, handsome male fox spirit employee. +1 — Starting from a shabby hut, Nan Xu worked hard in the mountains to survive. He repaired his house, farmed, raised chickens, upgraded his Inn, and welcomed more and more unique guests. Zhuyu Mountain rose high into the clouds. According to an ancient legend — almost no spirit could fly over its peaks. Later, an inn appeared on the mountain. Its owner was a fair-skinned human youth who looked especially tempting. Any small spirits who coveted him would find themselves chased by nightmares at night. — Years later, more and more spirits moved into the once deserted Zhuyu Mountain. There was a greedy, bird-like head of the publicity department and a poor cook. A socially anxious hedgehog spirit obsessed with growing herbs. A wild boar spirit and skilled farmer. … Everything went smoothly, except for one tricky request from a guest: The Jade Rabbit Spirit pinched her ear: “I’ve heard that the spicy rabbit head of the human race is especially delicious. Can I try it?” The Rainbow Cloud Spirit was filled with anticipation. “The Inn description says your beds are as soft as clouds. Is that true?” The Black Bear Spirit nodded shyly. “Could you send the fox spirit from your Inn to my room tonight?” Nan Xu looked at Tingchuan, who was watering the vegetable patch in the backyard, his fox tail visible. Ah, the “landlady” is a fox spirit after all! *Daily, slow-paced.* *A lighthearted, pastoral story set in the demon world, exploring the unconventional wilderness. *

title: The Evil God Is Going Back To Work
description: Four days ago, the evil god left the 《Unlimited Ghost Game》 and became the first player to ever leave the system. Four days later, Su Li woke up in the real world, from an evil god feared by all ghosts, to a miserable social animal with a crippling debt. Su Li, whose goal in life is to be a rich salted fish who can eat and sleep like a fool: “…” * Su Li began working at the Supernatural Section of the Bureau of Investigations as a delicate, weak, and timid intern. A colleague of the Supernatural Team: “Damn, you’re so weak. Rest assured, the task of catching ghosts will never fall on you.” Su Li: “Thank you; I’ll be relying on you then.” Su Li quickly slipped away from the scene, but when he turned around, all of his teammates were eaten up by ghosts. The malicious spirit proudly said, “Don’t worry, you’re next.” Su Li: “…” There was no choice; he could only roll up his sleeves and fight back. While fighting, Su Li noticed something wrong. Why were all these powerful ghosts his old acquaintances from the game? Those ghostly acquaintances were angry. “That dogsh*t system! Is this what you mean by an ordinary person deprived of power? Look at him beating me up, my head has been ripped off wuwuwu!!!” Su Li slowly tidied up his sleeves and raised the corners of his lips, revealing an extremely gentle smile: “Going back on one’s words, system, you’re really… looking for death.” ** He Duo, the new head of the He family. It’s said that this person was neither a human nor a ghost. Not only does he have a venomous personality, but he also acts extremely crazily. In front of him, people would respectfully refer to him as He-shao, but behind his back, they would refer to him as the mad dog. Then one day, he found out that he had a fiancé named Su Li. He Duo’s lips raised slightly as he smiled as lightly ordered his subordinates: “Then just peel off his skin.” * Afterwards—— Su Li sat on a soft sofa, stepping on He Duo’s knee as he spoke, “If you want to stay by my side, that’s fine. But, are you obedient enough?” * “I love you.” “I love you too, little puppy.”

title: The Transmigrated Villain Hates the Main Character
description: I transmigrated as Han Raon, the villainous sub-bottom in a novel. But due to the system’s forceful intervention, I was forced to feel jealous of the main bottom, to pathetically cling to the main top, and ultimately die acting out Han Raon’s role. “Han Raon! Get a hold of yourself!” As everyone coldly watched Raon dying, only Siwoo—one of the sub-tops—tried desperately to save him. He had suffered from chronic guiding deficiency, as Raon only chased after the main top despite being fated to pair with someone. With a heart full of remorse, Raon guides him one last time. “…Sorry…” “…Hyung.” And just when it seemed like everything was over… “The system?” Raon is sent three years into the past due to the system’s interference. But strangely enough, in this life, the system is quiet and nowhere to be found. “I hope you’re not misunderstanding—I have no feelings for you, Team Leader.” Thanks to that, he ruthlessly pushes away the arrogant and self-centered main top, and before dying again, proposes a pairing to Yoon Siwoo, the only sub-top who once cared for him. Luring in the wary Siwoo and guiding him goes well at first, but something feels off? “Hyung, h-hyung… ah… it feels so good…” “Hey, wait—!” The leash is off on the S-rank Esper who suffered from chronic guiding deficiency—and he’s not easy to handle. And if the system returns, Raon might have to go back to living as the villain again… At that moment, the system window appears again before the conflicted Raon: It seems the system has assigned Raon a new role.

title: Why Did I Have to Transmigrate as the Villain’s Younger Brother?
description: I found myself transmigrated into the fantasy novel “From Transmigration to Hero.” And not just as any character, but as Sean, the younger brother of the Villain Raizen—and the one who would eventually be killed by him. “An extra who’s already dead by the time the main story starts… seriously?” But despairing over it wouldn’t help, especially since Sean stood to inherit a fortune. So, I clenched my teeth and resolved to survive. Call Raizen “Big Brother” three times or more: 30/3 Spend at least 30 minutes with Raizen: 120/30 Hold Raizen’s hand for at least 5 seconds: 0/5 Reward: Access to From Transmigration to Hero’s main text and Raizen: Bonus Chapter] Even with these ridiculous quests, I managed to complete them somehow. All for the sake of survival, I acted as harmless as possible, pretending to be the little brother utterly devoted to Raizen. But then… “You’ve manifested as a Recessive Omega.” Suddenly, an unexpected setting that didn’t exist in the original story appeared. “You said it yourself. That you and I are the only two people in this world.” Even after I barely managed to escape, the villain chased me down to where I was hiding?!

title: There are Too Many Villains Besides Me
description: I woke up as the villain in a romance simulation game my younger sister loved. Not just any villain, but Ranshel—the servant who torments one of the capture targets, Zavad, only to meet a miserable end. “Eunhye, your brother is absolutely screwed…” To return to my original world in a healthy body, I need to die at Zavad’s hands, just like in the game. But from my so-called father, the duke, to my stepmother who entered the family later, and even the hidden eyes of the imperial family— There are way too many villains in this game besides Ranshel, and for Zavad, every single moment of his life is a crisis. If I want to die at Zavad’s hands, doesn’t that mean he has to survive first? In the end, Ranshel finds himself in a situation where he must protect Zavad from other villains— Only to betray him in the end and die. * * * “…Well, that works out for us. There’s no chance we’ll ever come to cherish each other anyway.” Ranshel smiled. Wasn’t that a good thing? Their relationship was nothing more than a contractual exchange. He would help Zavad become the head of his family, and in return, he’d receive an enormous sum of gold. Until Zavad gained enough power, he’d rely on Ranshel’s help, and when he could finally use his wealth freely, he’d pay him back. That was all there was to it. Zavad must have had similar thoughts because he curled his lips into a smirk, though his expression remained displeased. “Obviously. Why would I ever waste affection on someone as filthy as you, a commoner?” Filthy. Commoner. He put particular emphasis on those words. It was almost funny—his tone was so refined that even an insult didn’t quite sound like one. Ranshel knew he should laugh, but for some reason, the laughter didn’t come easily. So he forced himself to smile, tugging at his lips deliberately. “Right. Just like I have no intention of serving you with body and soul, you shouldn’t go around developing unnecessary feelings for me either. Just thinking about it is unpleasant.” Zavad scoffed in disbelief. “How ridiculous. Worry about yourself first. And stop staring at my face like some lovesick fool.”

title: Omega of the Duke Brothers
description: Adam Ross, an omega from a fallen noble family, lives alone with his younger sister. But when his sister is admitted to a hospital for long-term care, Adam finds himself in desperate need of more money. Just then, a sympathetic nobleman brings up an unexpected proposal. “I’ve heard the Dukes of the Carlisle family are looking for an omega.” The Carlisle Dukes—descendants of the house that built the current empire into a great power. At the helm of the prestigious Carlisle family are the two brothers: Isaac Carlisle, the elder, and Chester Carlisle, the younger. Praised as the most noble siblings in history, the two uniquely inherited the title of duke together and jointly govern their territory. Now, they’re seeking strong and healthy omegas to bear an heir. “You understand the terms of the contract, don’t you?” “Yes. It’s a contract to bear the heir of the Carlisle family.” After much deliberation, Adam eventually steps into the ducal bedchamber—for the sake of his sister. And so begins his dangerous contract with the Carlisle brothers. “You must sleep with both of us—so much that even you won’t know whose child you’re carrying. Over and over again.” Isaac Carlisle, the man who sees Adam as nothing more than a tool to produce an heir. “s*x isn’t a duty to me. It’s more like… a game.” Chester Carlisle, the charming yet arrogant man who makes Adam feel shame with his words alone. Adam, who had lived a quiet and modest life until now, finds his fate irrevocably changed after meeting the two dukes—

title: From Villain to S-Class Guide
description: After transmigrating, I found myself as Go Yeonwoo, a side villain who mu*dered the protagonist, Woo Jiyoo, only to be brutally killed by a group of S-Class Espers. To make matters worse, the moment I transmigrated was right after killing Woo Jiyoo. But unlike the original story, Go Yeonwoo awakens as an S-Class Guide. The Espers, upon sensing Go Yeonwoo’s guiding energy, start acting differently from the original. “This bastard, let’s take him and use him as our personal sl*t. Just killing him would be too easy a punishment.” “We’ll make him regret killing Woo Jiyoo. I’ll have him begging for death by the end.” The S-Class Espers fake Go Yeonwoo’s death and imprison him in a secret place, forcing him to guide them. However, with his already twisted tastes, Go Yeonwoo finds the Espers’ obsessive behavior suffocatingly delightful. He even pretends to resist, encouraging them to treat him even more recklessly. But then… “Hey, are you seriously stopping after eating just this much? Are you planning to starve yourself to death?” “Get lost, Kang Taewon. Because of you, my sl*t can’t eat properly. I’ll feed him myself. Open wide, Yeonwoo.” “Yeonwoo, is there something you want to say to me? You were jealous enough to kill Jiyoo over it, weren’t you? If you tell me now, I’ll listen. Go ahead.” “You’re letting me hold you up? Does that mean you’re giving me permission now?”

title: Survivorship Bias
description: On the server “Altar,” an upper-class survival game was officially launched. Survival was the only logic in the human game of alliance, betrayal, and human-natured games of deceit and treachery. After the smoke of gunpowder ends, only the survivors can speak. As soon as he opened his eyes, the amnesiac An Wujiu saw a person at his side killed. While in confusion, a floating green typeface appeared before him. Variable Name: An Wujiu Attributes: Male, 20 years old Game Rounds: 5 Win Rate: 100/100 Danger Rank: SSS No wonder they were afraid. The first time he saw An Wujiu, Shen Ti felt curious. The kindness and fragility in those eyes were not fake, so how could he survive in the Altar? It was until he saw the man had a sudden personality change. He recklessly gambled regardless of the cost, casually estranged people, grew further excited on the verge of death, and even calculated against himself to win. Only then did Shen Ti realize that it was his own cognitive bias. Fortunately, he wasn’t a normal person either.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: After Becoming Enemies With the Lord God
description: After realizing that he was only in a small world and that he was the son of destiny in this world and the target of all outsiders, Rong Yu awakened. He counterattacked and killed all 108 attackers, reversed his fate and escaped from the small world, causing turmoil in the larger worlds. This incident alerted the Lord God in charge of the worlds, who personally took action to arrest him, threw him into the small worlds with BE to rehabilitate. Dressed as a carp about to be braised, a prisoner who was framed, a bride who was buried… Rong Yu risked his life in every mission, changing the BE ending into a HE ending. Blood Jade Bracelet: This is a punishment, so the mission is very difficult. You have to survive every time… Wait a minute, why is the Lord God here too? Lord God: Has he been wronged? Blood Jade Bracelet: He is about to massacre the city. ​ —— ​ Probably a master god chasing fugitives, he chases and gains additional emotions without realizing it. After being caught, he can’t bear to kill him, so he throws him into the BE sadistic world for punishment. After being thrown into it, he is still very worried, so he chases him and changes the BE sadistic world for him. A sweet story. Sweet text, mainly about daily relationships, supplemented by slaps in the face and ab*se of scum. The wanton demon king shou vs. the ruthless main god gong.

title: Becoming a God by Playing the Prophet [Infinite]
description: Xie Yi’an transmigrated into a high-risk world. Right from the start, he triggered a special event and was forced to bind a hidden identity card with an extremely high mortality rate. The beginner’s gift pack he received was the universally acknowledged tr*sh ability 【Performance Rules】. At the same time, he discovered a secret: Every player entering the dungeon was bound to an invisible live stream, where mysterious viewers were mockingly watching the players’ life-and-death struggles. He was the only player who knew about the live stream and could see the viewers’ comments. Xie Yi’an: … This looks like a surefire way to die. A normal person would already be considering restarting. Not only was Xie Yi’an not afraid, but he even came up with a bold idea. The viewers were familiar with the dungeon’s plot development, and every comment could reveal crucial clues. Only he could see the comments, only he could know the information that would affect the “future.” With such an information advantage, why not play the prophet and trick some NPCs? Xie Yi’an decisively started acting. – From the day the anomalies descended, humanity has never gained the upper hand in the war against them. The dungeons carrying the anomalies appeared without any pattern. Every time a dungeon appeared, it claimed countless lives, and decades of darkness left people in despair. Until the 【Prophet】 appeared. Xie Yi’an repeatedly turned the tide for humanity. He became the spiritual pillar for countless players, a private deity for humanity. – Players: I heard the Prophet can even control anomalies (worship.jpg). Viewers: Hah, foolish players, he can only foresee the future. Controlling anomalies is just him tricking NPCs, it’s fake! Xie Yi’an: Actually, the prophecies are fake too 😀 – Xie Yi’an looked at his fully leveled 【Performance Rules】. Even though it’s all fake, with great acting skills, you can really do anything. ★: The male lead is split into two but only two slices (?) 【Li Wei】 and 【Xuan An】 are the same person, other details involve the main plot so no spoilers here. ★: The male lead is not a background character, it’s just that I didn’t know how to write him into the synopsis, but he has a lot of scenes in the main text. ★: This is a fictional world, please do not relate it to reality, all settings in the story are fabricated, the novel’s settings are just for fun qwq.

title: Everyone Knows I’m a Good Person
description: Shi Qing’s task was to be a protector. It was only after transmigrating to various worlds and eagerly counterattacking the villains there that he realized he was the biggest villain out of everyone. – A king that liked to conquer other worlds – A Film Emperor that had a malicious personality – A Blackened Young Master with deviant intentions – A Schoolyard Bully that was overbearing to others Afterwards the gong that initially despised Shi Qing discovered: – The Machine King that seemed like an invader was really a million-year-old baby – The Film Emperor that seemed malicious was secretly helping upcoming actors – The Young Master that seemed to harbor deviant intentions was a pure-hearted young boy – The Schoolyard Bully that seemed overbearing was secretly in love In the end…. The entire world: He’s such a good person!
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Misidentified as a Bug Again [Infinite]
description: Zhu Ling had spent ten years in a psychiatric hospital. Until one day, he was dragged into a bizarre and dangerous game. The moment Zhu Ling’s livestream automatically started, viewers were greeted by a bewildered yet strikingly beautiful young man. Not only was Zhu Ling’s appearance captivating, but he also exuded an air of fragile vulnerability that tugged at the heartstrings. His player stats, clearly displayed on his panel, showed nothing but a row of utterly useless attributes. Countless viewers sighed: What a shame, just a pretty face with no substance. Some gleeful players even boldly predicted how he would meet his demise. That was until they saw the ruthless NPCs hunting down other players—nurses who had cared for Zhu Ling for ten years, or the deranged NPCs conducting experiments on other players—who turned out to be Zhu Ling’s former attending physician… Every NPC treated Zhu Ling with utmost care, a stark contrast to their cruel and merciless behavior toward other players. In the first instance, players dismissed it as coincidence. In the second instance, the boss was Zhu Ling’s former hospital roommate. In the third, the boss was his classmate… It wasn’t until Zhu Ling flawlessly cleared instance after instance—without a single point added to his stats—that players gasped in realization: Zhu Ling must be a self-aware NPC! Exploiting the “acquaintance advantage” to cheese the game, huh? Furious, players reported him to the system. Zhu Ling flipped open his player panel with a scoff: “Acquaintance advantage?” His SSS-tier stats blinded everyone in disbelief.

title: Show Me Your Stats!
description: One day, a shocking piece of news arrives in the city of wizards. The entire family of wizard Solar Sing Eira has died— and so, he is to become the next Lord Solar. But the hometown he returns to in a hurry feels completely unfamiliar. He barely manages to hold the funeral with some shady retainers, then faints from sheer stress and exhaustion. When he opens his eyes again… Hello, Master! Nice to meet you! ^o^ I’m your adorable Spirit GM here to assist with your dream-filled and I’m so excited to be working with you! Yahoo! Before we begin, would you like to name me? ☞ Enter Name ______ A pebble-like spirit just called me “Master”…? Level-up quests, and even notification windows that look exactly like a UI from my previous life’s games. Wait… why does this feel like modern gaming? Reminded of the games he used to love, he decides to take on the quests— and take a look around his territory while he’s at it. But that territory… “234 days until collapse…?” Well. First things first—let’s get the succession ceremony over with. Somehow… we’ll manage.

title: After Killing My Way Through the Instance, I Raised the Evil God Within the Rules
description: (Gong is not human, horror monsters, proceed with caution) Yin Xiu has lived in the Rules Town for six years. Normal players who enter diligently grind dungeons, busy surviving, but Yin Xiu stays in town every day without leaving, avoiding dungeons and monsters, idling his time away, even starting to retire. The town’s monsters have had their eyes on him for six years, grinding their teeth in frustration. Despite all their efforts, they’ve never managed to drag him into their schemes. Day after day, they watch him stroll by, powerless against someone who’s memorized every rule. A few days later, heavy rain falls on the town, and a new batch of players arrives. That night, a mysterious man forced to share Yin Xiu’s room accomplishes what the town’s monsters couldn’t in six years—he drags Yin Xiu into a rules dungeon. That evening, the town’s monsters gather in celebration: Hooray! Finally, that slacker retiree is gone! Meanwhile, the dungeon monsters begin to wail: Who dragged that man back in—the one who slaughtered his way through dungeons six years ago?! We barely managed to kick him out back then!!! Upon entering the dungeon, Yin Xiu shows little interest. Sword in hand, he glances around: Same old, no novelty. Let’s speedrun this and go back to retirement. The dungeon monsters collectively sigh in relief, about to pop the champagne early, when a row of twisted, blood-red words suddenly appears before Yin Xiu: Do I look novel enough for you? A viscous, chilling dread instantly descends upon the entire dungeon. Monsters and players alike begin to panic. “It” has emerged. — A max-level veteran returning to old dungeons to stomp noobs is just routine. Is it weird to retire after slaughtering through dungeons? Cultivating peace and feeding an evil god—perfectly normal, right? Why stare at me? My strategies aren’t for you to copy.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Archenemy Contract
description: A young noble’s attempt to summon a demon fails, and he dies on the spot. Bad news: He accidentally summons a Chaos Demon God, who takes control of the sacrificial s*ave’s body. Good news: He accidentally summons the heroic spirit who annihilated that very Demon God. This spirit now inhabits the young noble’s body. When sworn enemies meet, they see red. But now, neither has their world-destroying power, and for some bizarre reason, they can’t kill each other. Even worse, the outside world has been completely turned upside down, and all their legends are nothing but myths. So, for the first time, they reach a consensus: they’ll get their powers back, figure out the current situation, and then try their best to kill each other— Character Breakdown Hero (Gong) × Lost-Body Demon God (Shou) The bitter (?) tale of two legends restarting in a noob village, from mutual destruction to an adventure of life-and-death companionship. Strong-Strong / HE (Happy Ending)

title: Ghost Stories With Different Rules (Infinite Flow)
description: Qin Fei’s greatest talent is manipulating people. With just a few words, he can make the dead seem alive and white appear black. One day, he accidentally enters a live broadcast of rule-based ghost stories. The system assigns Qin Fei a special ability:

title: Perennial Species
description: People with the ability to hunt mutants, Mansaengjong. One day, they suddenly found themselves isolated in Naraka. Seowoon was once called a highest-ranked and known for his excellent combat capabilities, but he suddenly lost all of those abilities after being isolated in Naraka. Instead, he gained the ability to detect the emergence of mutants through the “Messenger”. To escape Naraka, a by-product of mutants called wu ore was needed. However, Seowoon would die even if he just brushed against a mutant, let alone hunting them. Upon learning this fact, Cahaya made a proposal to him: “Cha Seowoon, from now on, be my mutant searcher?” With Cahaya’s help, Seowoon was able to travel back and forth to Seoul, but he found it more and more difficult. ‘Why did I push you away……?’ He just wanted to deny the feelings of attraction that he felt towards Cahaya.

title: Is Love a Luxury in a Zombie Game?
description: After Yuwon clears the notoriously difficult zombie game with a no-damage run, he wakes up the next day inside the game— as the protagonist’s ex-lover’s boyfriend! Time remaining until zombie outbreak: 09:59:10 : Return] If he follows the system’s instructions and achieves a no-damage clear with Seojun, the protagonist, he can go back home. The problem is— “What kind of insane soap opera is this?” Seojun is a love-obsessed maniac who would even endure endless regressions for the sake of his ex-lover. If he ever finds out that Yuwon is that ex-lover’s boyfriend, Yuwon’s as good as dead. But then, Seojun, who was supposed to be using him, starts to react strangely… “Don’t leave me. Hyung.” Seojun, pulling Yuwon tightly into his arms, said with clear eyes, “You promised. That you’d stay with me.” ※ This work contains elements such as domestic violence and gaslighting that may be triggering. Please take caution when reading.

title: In Zombie Stories, T*ash Always Survives the Longest
description: ⚠ Content Warning: This work contains significant themes of psychological ab*se, violence, confinement, r*pe, mu*der, and coercion, which may be distressing. Please be aware when reading. All settings and backgrounds in this work are purely fictional. Any resemblance to real locations, people, or organizations is purely coincidental. Suddenly, zombies appeared at school. In order to survive, Tae-jung threw everyone he saw in front of him to be eaten by zombies and managed to reach the classroom—where he ran into Si-chan, someone he had absolutely despised. The two of them shared one thing in common: As long as they survived, nothing else mattered. If someone looked even slightly bitten, they killed them on the spot. If someone was too loud, they used them as zombie shields. And even if someone quietly followed their orders, they still used them as zombie bait. Realizing their similar ways of thinking, Tae-jung and Si-chan formed an alliance. But as they continued surviving together, Tae-jung started feeling a growing sense of unease. “Not gonna kill you, not gonna kill you.” “Then why the f*ck did you pull that shit, you crazy bastard…?” “Because I wanted to see you beg.” In a field full of zombies, where they played with human lives like toys— “Does this hurt? Did that hurt?” “Ghk—f*ck—ghhk… cough…” Si-chan would choke him for fun, laughing at his suffering. Tae-jung realized that at this rate, he would die. He decided he had to switch to another group as soon as possible— But it wasn’t easy. “Come with me. Or just f*cking die right now.” After all, Si-chan, who once called him useless, now refused to let him go.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: The Narrow-Eyed Villain of the Demon Academy
description: The worst and strongest villain. I became the narrow-eyed character Arsene Adel. “Revenge.” It sounded good. At least to the original owner of the body. But from my point of view, the goal is not revenge, but survival. I didn’t have the confidence to survive among humans, so ㅡI went to the Demon Realm. Where I was headed, A school for demons that is said to be attended by the children of prestigious families in the demon world, ……It was a school that terrorized the human world.

title: Declaration of a Fraudulent Relationship
description: Celestial Wind was the number one virtual reality MMORPG game in Korea. Lured in by a large-scale update, Limousine entered the game after a long hiatus. ‘Huh?’ Someone had already messed with his main quest. The moment he realized that, the entrance to the dungeon was restricted, and he was forced to turn away. He didn’t know who did it, but they wouldn’t mess with him so easily the second time around. He’ll start from here. …Or at least that’s what he thought.

title: The Aesthetic of Beautiful, Strong, and Tragic
description: Gong Du is the most unpopular deity in the Three Thousand Divine Realms, controlling worldly diseases. Every world has a protagonist group that gathers all the world’s fortune. His job is to escort the protagonist group while also providing them with enough trials to obtain fortune. Gong Du painstakingly creates obstacles for the protagonist group while simultaneously acting as their teacher/senior/comrade to provide guidance. But his ending has already been predetermined—destined for death. World One: Gong Du plays the gentle white moonlight teacher while using his Federal Admiral identity to create trials for the protagonist group. Later, he uses his Admiral identity to kill his own white moonlight persona, forcing the protagonist group to strive harder to overthrow the Federation. But… before dying, Gong Du looks at the protagonist group crying their hearts out and falls into silence. World Two: Golden sunflowers always follow the sun; the flamboyant youth holds flowers and disappears in the sunlight. “I die in the past, guarding your future.” World Three: Ancient treacherous minister arc Statements from various protagonist groups: In countless worlds, there exists such a person. Sometimes walking alone on a path covered with thorns. Sometimes dying in the darkness before dawn. Sometimes servile and flattering, yet straightening their spine before death. Sometimes never able to grasp the light they swore to protect with their life. This person is their teacher/senior/companion, a guide to many, and also their most untouchable regret. PS: The protagonist is not a good person—very scummy, extremely scummy. A master actor who follows scripts perfectly without breaking character, quietly selling misery with expertise. All relationships are friendship/familial oriented. PPS: Specific warnings + reading guide in the author’s notes of Chapter 1 One-line Summary: Want to understand the beautiful, strong, and tragic script? Theme: Look at people comprehensively

title: Narcissistic Patient [Quick Transmigration]
description: You Ye started acting at the age of 12, praised by the media as a “genius experiential actor,” with no role he couldn’t master. For You Ye, acting was life itself, but on his 27th birthday, he encountered an accident on his way to the film set. On the brink of death, the birthday song and the cold voice of the system echoed— “Welcome to the [Patient Interpretation] system.” “Only by perfectly interpreting the role of the [patient] in each world and gaining the approval of the behind-the-scenes director can you regain your life.” “We regret to inform you that the director randomly matched to you is quite perverse; no one has successfully navigated his storyline to date.” You Ye felt no turmoil within, even laughing: “I also regret to inform this director that his record is about to be broken.” Thus, he perfectly portrayed the “sickly vase artist craving human blood,” the “defective robot that cries when touched,” and the “psychiatrist searching for his missing second personality”… He was both an actor and a patient. He brought to life the contradictory yet captivating roles with great flair. … In a parallel world, You Ye died in an accident eighteen years ago. After his death, he worked in the quick-transmigration world, personally building the [Patient Interpretation] system, code-named 202. Only by encountering an actor who belongs to him, perfectly interpreting the roles he set, can 202 return to the past, erase regrets, and fulfill wishes. 202 waited for eighteen years and finally met his chosen actor on his birthday. But he did not know the other’s identity—another version of himself from a parallel world. 202 made a cameo in the script, meeting himself in different worlds, performing together. Then they fell in love and revealed their true selves. You Ye: Sorry, I’m a bit narcissistic. 202: What a coincidence, so am I. Consumption Guide: Self-attack and self-receive variant, parallel universe type self-attack and self-receive, with different death times and events for the protagonists in the two worlds; The roles interpreted may not follow the order in the synopsis and may be modified; everything is subject to the main text; A self-exploratory work, non-typical quick-transmigration, with elements of fantasy, infinite flow, and suspense; One-sentence Summary: Acting with oneself in a parallel world. Theme: Those who love their careers are truly remarkable.

title: High Energy Alert! A Little ‘Milk Bun’ Descends and Shakes Up the Wealthy Family
description: Overnight, Niuniu became a pitiful little orphan without father or mother. Little Niuniu went to the city to find relatives with an uneasy heart, but gained a bunch of uncles and big shots! The big men who were originally extremely impatient with children… were completely won over when facing Niuniu! Galaxy’s Top General Eldest Uncle: “Niuniu, do you like watching fireworks? How about Uncle sets off an atomic bomb for you to see the mushroom cloud?” Second Uncle, who is rich enough to rival a nation: “Niuniu, come to Second Uncle’s side. Little Niuniu, don’t you like flowers? Second Uncle has many flowers here: gold flowers, silver flowers, and ‘money to spend’ flowers. Which one does Niuniu like? Just take it!” Third Uncle, the Ten Gold Film Emperor of the Entertainment Circle: “Niuniu, how about accompanying Uncle to the evening party to cut the ribbon tonight?” Interstellar Detective Little Maternal Uncle: “Niuniu, come and help Uncle calculate who the mu*derer of this case is!” But the mysterious Daddy scooped up Little Niuniu: “My daughter, I will pamper her!” The little dumpling in his arms was extremely restless: “I want Chen Gege!!” Everyone’s eyes slightly narrowed, and a dangerous arc curved on the corners of their mouths: “Chen Gege?”

title: The Villain’s Mom Becomes Famous for Fortune-Telling and Gossip
description: Yu Yuan has been following her master in the mystical sect since childhood, originally destined to live a peaceful life and pass away naturally. That is until one day, she suddenly suffers a heart attack—only to wake up as the mother of the ultimate villain in a classic level-up novel. In the original book, the villain’s mother is just cannon fodder living among villains. Her main role is to create a dark childhood for the villain, and then she dies, allowing the villain to end up in an orphanage. The bound melon-eating system cheerfully announces: [Host, you will die in a week. Hurry up and eat melons!] Facing complete chaos, Yu Yuan: “…” Don’t panic. These are all small problems. For the sake of her life, she binds the live melon-eating system, and while telling fortunes and eating melons in the livestream, she waits for people to send her “hush money.” The onlookers eagerly compile all the hottest gossip, including but not limited to: “The Phoenix Man CEO’s Ghostly Father-in-Law,” “The Dead Son’s Green Hat,” and “Just How Many Mistresses Do You Have—Third, Fourth, Fifth, or Even Sixth?!”—a thrilling lineup of this year’s top dramas. At first, when the black fans hear that the unknown Yu Yuan is going to tell fortunes, they almost laugh their heads off: “With her high school education, she’s telling fortunes for people? Let me see who gets fooled!” That night, the rich wife @Yu Yuan posts: “Thanks to the Master’s advice, my grandson is indeed not my own.” Then she openly bans the daughter-in-law who cheated on her deceased son. The black fans collectively shocked.jpg “Is this made up?” The onlookers: “She’s the godmother of the entertainment industry. How could an unknown celebrity get her to make up a story?” The rich heiress who marries a ‘Phoenix Man,’ the wealthy lady who unknowingly adopts her husband’s biological son, the corporate queen drained dry by her own younger brother, and the unlucky CEO whose ancestral grave gets dug up—all step forward to claim their share of the drama, leaving the black fans utterly speechless. Even bigger entertainment scandals keep surfacing, with major studios anxiously checking in every day: “Hello? Sister Yu? No scandals about our artists today, right…? If there are, please don’t rush to spill! We’re willing to pay—name your price!” The black fan who gets slapped in the face hesitates, pinches the corner of his clothes, and shyly asks: “Well, Master Yu Yuan, can you help me calculate my peach blossom?” ⁕ Yu Liang has a dream—one where he is the son of the real heiress in a cliché ‘Fake vs. Real Daughter’ novel. The problem? His mom is the cannon fodder real daughter… who dies early in the plot. Looking at his mother, who is still livestreaming while living a peaceful life, the frightened Yu Liang pulls the ghost friend he just met to analyze his nightmare. The century-old ghost king, who gets caught as a nanny, looks like he has no desire to live: “…” Little Master, stop messing around! With your mom’s combat power, does she look like someone who would ever suffer a loss? Instead of thinking about all this nonsense, why not focus on something more important—like what’s for dinner? He hasn’t even started cooking yet…

title: After the Group Disbanded, I Became Famous!
description: After waking up from a nap, actor Lu Xu found himself transmigrated into a member of the popular idol boy group Verse. The good news is, he has a handsome face. The bad news is, Verse had just disbanded, and Lu Xu not only became the least popular member, but he was also the only one kicked out of the company. Verse fans only had “three favorites” left. A quick search of the keyword “Lu Xu” turns up thousands of scandals, with even stray dogs wanting to kick him. While his former teammates are skyrocketing with new opportunities, he’s stuck with a contract for a terrible web drama, playing a greasy second male lead, and his savings aren’t even enough to pay the penalty for breach of contract. How to turn things around? That’s the question. #Everyone knows this is a crazy web drama, but still can’t resist being drawn in by the craziness# #Among a sea of greasy guys, the second male lead is actually not greasy at all# Everyone thought that after Verse disbanded, Lu Xu would become an unknown, but to everyone’s surprise, he started from the bottom with a tr*shy web drama, and with every drama he shot, he became more and more popular, steadily rising to the top. #NoRomance

title: Lie Crusher
description: Xia Chengcheng was a paparazzi. She worked tirelessly, diligently staking out celebrity spots and snapping photos every single day. She finally managed to catch a major scoop, only to die suddenly. After being reborn, Xia Chengcheng found herself inside an entertainment-industry novel, taking the role of a universally hated actress— the foil to the pure and innocent female protagonist. Article 1: Top Idol Secretly Married for Years and Has a Son! Article 2: Famous Power Couple in the Industry Has Been Divorced for Years! Article 3: Casting Director Caught mol*sting Rising Starlet! So many scandals! She didn’t even know which one to expose first! It was a paparazzi’s paradise! The system spoke with a serious tone, 〖Host, as the novel’s female supporting character, your task is to enter the entertainment industry and compete with the white lotus female protagonist for favor! Win the love of the domineering CEO male protagonist!〗 Xia Chengcheng: “???” Was the system out of its mind? With all these scoops, wouldn’t starting a gossip account and making money be way more profitable?
