title: I Livestream Divination To The World
description: An Rugu just graduated from university and returned to her small, mountain village to inherit a rundown Daoist temple. The Daoist temple is simple and solemn, but there are no visitors, and there is no money for incense. She heard that doing livestreams can earn money, so she decided to give it a try. But her livestream isn’t singing and dancing—she tells fortunes. —————— A divination livestream appeared on the Shark streaming platform, and the netizens who saw it dismissed it at first. But soon enough, the comments changed completely. After becoming popular, An Rugu somehow took over the task of promoting the Netherworld and became its spokesperson to the living. Livestream divination to the living during the day—live attraction for ghosts at night. ————— Slice of life—except that An Rugu’s daily life consists of livestream divinations, conversing with denizens of the Netherworld, and running a halfway home for ghosts who don’t want to reincarnate yet. Oh, and she also manages a small Daoist temple atop a pretty mountain with a magnificent view of the sky, rising through the clouds.

title: Fortune Teller Master
description:
Fortune Telling, a mysterious technique, can also be said dangerous because it can change the catastrophe and make it auspicious… Teacher: Don’t give me these useless papers to me, have you finished answering your test paper?
Lin Qingyin took out a tortoiseshell: Teacher, can I use divination to get the answer? Lin Qingyin, the master of fortune-telling, didn’t succeed in the Thunder Tribulation when she tried to ascend. When she woke up again, she became a high school student. Lin Qingyin, who was not afraid of Thunder Tribulation, looked at the thick test paper in front of her and shivered. Only a thousand years had passed, how could the world become so scary!

title: People Who Eat Melon Are in 70
description: As a melon-eater in the new era, Jiang Youtao is like a melon in the melon field. She can be found wherever there are melons. So on a thunderstorm night with lightning and lightning, she traveled through time and space. , dressed as a poor girl with the same name from the 1970s. The poor little girl lost her mother in her early years, and her s*umbag father married another woman. Not only did she not have enough food and clothing, but she also had endless housework to do and endless hardships…

title: The Little Widow of the Sixties
description: The young widow’s husband died, and she was kicked out of her husband’s house because she couldn’t give birth. At this lowest point in her life, she got a melon-eating system. Eat melons and watch the show, and win gold coins steadily. The ex-mother-in-law tortured her daughter-in-law, causing her to almost jump into the well. She: Why jump into a well? If you’re going to live, live well. Well, now the melons of the ex-husband’s family are eaten one after another, and she keeps earning points. Relying on the melon-eating system, she supports herself and is busy at the forefront of melon-eating every day. Hearing that the eldest daughter of the Xu family is going on a blind date today, she put down her shoes and went out. In the main room, there is only one man in a Zhongshan suit sitting there. As she enters, she doesn’t see the eldest daughter of the Xu family. The man looks up and meets her eyes, stands up to greet her, and then introduces himself. “My name is Zhou Qingshan, twenty-nine years old. After transitioning from the military, I work at a steel factory. I have an elderly mother and younger siblings at home. I was injured on duty, but after marriage, I can help arrange a job.” Afterwards, the man said to the matchmaker: “It’s just right that the daughter of the Xu family is not happy. I think the female comrade that day was good.” “She is a widow.” “It doesn’t matter. I’m not young either, and I have two younger sisters at home.” She married herself out of melon-eating, and her husband’s family arranged a job for her, and she became a formal employee. Day after day, she still struggles on the front line of melon-eating. System: Wow, you actually became the sister-in-law of the tragic heroine. Looking forward to your performance!

title: Green Tea Goes Viral After Being Forced to Tell the Truth
description:
Ning Chuchu—a well-known green tea in the entertainment industry, best in lying and seducing others, but with poor popularity among the public. One day, everyone suddenly discovered that the green tea had changed… In a romance variety show: A s*umbag male guest affectionately said, “Chuchu, you look so beautiful when you cook. But be careful not to tire yourself out.” Ning Chuchu replied, “Are you a garbage bag? How good at pretending. Instead of worrying about me getting tired, why don’t you come over and help?” s*umbag male lead, “…?” Ning Chuchu closed off her heart and crushed all the male contestants, not meeting a worthy opponent. In the end, the production team asked her to choose one male contestant to hold hands with, and she… Took away the stray dog the production team had adopted. A male dog. —What was originally a romance show turned into Ning Chuchu’s comedy solo. During an interview: Reporter: “Was your collaboration with Director Song pleasant?” Ning Chuchu: “It’s okay. It would’ve been better if he stopped knocking on actress’ doors all the time.” — Director Song, a well-known figure in the entertainment industry, was blacklisted due to the unspoken rules he imposed on others. Forced to do a live-stream sales promotion by her agency, Ning Chuchu smiled and said: “Look at this face mask…  It’s completely useless.” “My skin is so good… Of course, it has nothing to do with face masks.” “If you have money, go for cosmetic procedures. Buying this is just a waste.” – Agency: …facepalm.jpg In the end, the well-known green tea became a “s*umbag detector,” a “holder of the hammer of Thor,” and a “level ten roasting master.” Countless fans loved her madly, peers praised her endlessly, and even her s*umbag father left all his assets to her in his will. Ning Chuchu humble-braggingly complained: I didn’t want it to be like this, it’s all because of the Truth System forcing me! In the entertainment industry, s*umbags trembled in fear, afraid of being exposed by the fearless and straightforward Ning Chuchu. Many people wanted to blacklist her, smear her name, but she always managed to turn the tables and rise higher. Later on, someone finally dug up some dirt on her:
As a rising star, Ning Chuchu actually had a fiancé! When the news came out, the whole internet boiled. Ning Chuchu refuted the rumors: It’s a business arrangement. There are no feelings involved, and the engagement will be dissolved soon. Netizens: …Damn, you’re so ruthless that you even exposed yourself?! However, her fiancé, a young and powerful figure from a wealthy family, publicly stated: Wedding preparations are underway. Ning Chuchu: …You didn’t have this attitude before 🙂 The fiancé smiled faintly. #The truth might be delayed, but it will never be absent# Ning Chuchu: After being a “green tea” for so many years, it turns out that speaking the truth is gratifying!

title: Writing Melodramatic Stories in Ancient Times Made Me Famous
description: Writer of melodramatic novels, Fu Wenyu, finds himself transmigrated into ancient times. The original owner of the body had a father who tragically fell ill and died while traveling to take the imperial exam. Not only did this deplete the family’s savings, but it also left them in dire straits. This stirred up a hornet’s nest! Their greedy uncle and aunt immediately turned against them, dividing the family property and driving Fu Wenyu’s household out. Faced with a leaking thatched hut and a confused mother and younger sister, Fu Wenyu rolled up his sleeves and decided to fall back on his old profession. He was ready to churn out ten thousand words a day without breaking a sweat! The first branch of the Fu family was kicked out, and the whole village waited to see them fall into ruin. But instead of collapsing, they watched Fu Wenyu pick up a pen and start writing storybooks. He was writing books while taking the imperial examination, he led his family out of Fujia Village, past the provincial capital, and all the way to the imperial city. Meanwhile, wuxia rebirth stories, imperial exam cultivation fantasies, supernatural mysteries, infinite genre tales, and futuristic novels took the literary world by storm, spreading across the nation. Alongside these were “merchandise,” “stage plays,” and “theme parks” springing up everywhere, all in high demand. And it didn’t stop there—his melodramatic stories started coming true! When he wrote “The True and False Young Master”, a certain Master Tang discovered his son had been switched at birth by a servant. When he wrote “The Legendary Stone Gambler”, the big stone used to press pickles at the house of Mrs. Wang in the next county was discovered to be a piece of jade, and she became rich overnight. When he wrote “Tragic Love and Deep Affection”, a certain marquis reunited with his long-lost wife, who had run away while pregnant years ago. The couple resolved their misunderstandings, rekindled their love, and even recognized a daughter who had been bickering with him daily. When he wrote “Imperial Exam Cultivation”… When he wrote “Romance and Foraging Go Hand in Hand”… Dumbfounded readers scrambled to hand over their wallets and kneel in reverence: “Master Fu, write about me! Write about me!”

title: The Gossip Revealed That My Whole Family Are Big Shots
description: Zhan Yan had always thought of himself as an ordinary person from an ordinary family, adopted by an ordinary family, and bound to an ordinary gossip system. Until one day, when his gentle and reliable father came home smelling strongly of perfume. Zhan Yan suspiciously opened the gossip system: 【The Demon King of the Wan Yao (Ten Thousand Demon) Alliance, Zhan Yunkai, accidentally got pollen from the corpse flower devil’s yam while chasing a traitor. To prevent his wife and child from finding out, he took seven baths and used up an entire bottle of perfume before coming home.】 Zhan Yan: Eyes shaking in disbelief! Then one day, his elegant and beautiful mother didn’t come home by midnight and didn’t answer her phone. Zhan Yan, worried, opened the gossip system: 【Top combatant of the Abnormal Affairs Management Bureau, Ji Yueming, got trapped in a maze after forgetting the password when leaving the bureau’s secret area. To get home quickly, she is angrily tearing down the maze.】 Zhan Yan: ??? Wait a minute! Isn’t the Abnormal Affairs Management Bureau an enemy organization of the Wan Yao Alliance?! Zhan Yan frantically searched the gossip system and finally found where the two met: 【Zhan Yunkai fell in love with Ji Yueming at first sight during the Lantern Festival and decided to hide his identity to date and marry her.】 【Ji Yueming fell in love with Zhan Yunkai at first sight during the Lantern Festival and decided to hide her identity to date and marry him.】 Zhan Yan: Wow! You both are wearing fake identities, huh?! The harmonious and happy family is facing a crisis of breaking apart, and Zhan Yan is very worried. He starts frantically searching the gossip system to see if there’s any information that can help make everyone friends instead of enemies. Then, he discovers that his older brother, Zhan Jinli, is the reincarnation of the Ghost King, and his second sister, Zhan Suiyu, is a superpowered person who came back from the apocalypse. Everyone thinks the others are ordinary people, and they are all trying to hide their true selves to maintain this ordinary and happy family. · Zhan Yan has a boyfriend, Gu Jiancheng, who is handsome, has a good personality, but is a bit clingy. Recently, Zhan Yan has been busy trying to save his crumbling family, so he’s been neglecting his boyfriend. Gu Jiancheng brings up their previous agreement to meet his parents. Zhan Yan hesitates: “How about we forget it?” Gu Jiancheng, heartbroken: “Why? Do you not love me anymore?” Zhan Yan: “No, it’s just that things are a bit complicated right now.” To divert his boyfriend’s attention, Zhan Yan starts looking up Gu Jiancheng’s gossip: 【Gu Jiancheng, feeling upset, brutally killed a hundred monsters that entered the real world from the Infinite World.】 Zhan Yan slowly lowers his head to look at Gu Jiancheng. Gu Jiancheng hugs his waist and doesn’t let go, rubbing his shoulder with a grievance: “Yan Yan, you’ve been so cold to me lately. You didn’t even give me a goodnight kiss last night.”

title: Fortune-Telling Live Broadcast
description: She became the real daughter who was brought back home by the Lu Family. Her mother always disliked her country bumpkin character. Her brother always disliked her because her existence made the fake daughter sad. The original owner of the body was very sad. But after becoming her, what she only cared was about cultivating. Fortunately, she has excellent bones. Even if the spiritual energy in the surroundings was very weak, she could use merits to re-cultivate back to immortality. Thus, a fortune-telling [Confusion Live Room] channel appeared on the Douji Platform.

title: After Swapping Lives, the Metaphysics Side Character Became the Wealthy Family’s Beloved
description: Li Qiao, a master of the occult, transmigrated into the ill-fated true heiress of a tr*shy novel—a cannon-fodder character whose identity was stolen by her adoptive sister, leaving her trapped in a remote mountain village forever. But just as her biological parents came to claim her, the adoptive sister suddenly changed her tune and pushed her into their arms. In elite Beijing circles, rumors spread like wildfire: The bumpkin the Li family brought back is a lunatic! They said she loved roaming at midnight, wielding a peachwood sword and kicking down the doors of wealthy mansions. Outraged, the tycoons stormed the Li family to complain. …Until later, when those same tycoons scrambled to beg on their knees, hauling lavish gifts: “Grandmaster, save me first!” Then, when Li Qiao started appearing arm-in-arm with that man next door, the elite gasped: “Grandmaster, you’re as good as dead!” The upper crust frantically called their heirs—Now’s the time to steal her away and save her! The man next door smirked: “Heh. Let the clowns dance.” While Li Qiao rose to fame in the capital and gained national renown, her adopted sister—now the mother of three daughters—finally snapped. One day, she kicked over a pot of pork stew and screamed in frustration:”We swapped lives! So why is she still living better than me?!”

title: Cloud Raising Little Zombies [Live Broadcast]
description: On JJ Live, a livestream channel named [Apocalypse] appeared. Viewers entered the channel to see a dimly lit room with a pale-faced boy slowly tilting his head, his crimson, pupil-less eyes wide open. The viewers outside the screen transformed into prairie dogs. 【Ah ah ah, I can totally handle this kind of endearingly silly zombie cub!】 Fans became addicted to raising the little zombie, determined to nurture him into the most refined zombie of the apocalypse. 【Zai Zai, take an umbrella. The sun’s been really harsh on zombies lately.】 Ye You: “Okay.” Apocalypse Realm: Zombie Emperor’s Cultivation Magic Realm: Necromancer God’s Cultivation Cultivation Realm: Underworld Lord’s Cultivation Cultivation Realm: Co-Master of the Six Realms’ Cultivation User Guide: ☆ No CP, Quick Transmigration, Level-Up, Nurturing System ☆ Livestream Channel Cloud Raising A Little Zombie Content Tags: Apocalypse, Quick Transmigration,Shuangwen (feel-good novel), Livestream One sentence summary: Ah ah ah, I can totally handle this kind of endearingly silly zombie cub! Concept: No matter how difficult the situation is, as long as you have a firm determination, you can be reborn in Nirvana.

title: I Use the System Panel to Pretend to Be a Charlatan
description: Qin Qing possessed the character panel from a game—before her, everyone was like an open book. She even understood people better than they understood themselves. After all, no one could fully quantify and digitize every aspect of their being. At first, she felt embarrassed about invading others’ privacy and had no idea what use the panel could be. Until one day, while walking down the street, the panel suddenly issued a warning: Qin Qing looked at the person and searched their name from the panel online, only to discover they were an A-level wanted criminal. She immediately reported them to the police. The criminal was apprehended, and she received a substantial reward. Only then did she realize the panel could not only help her do meaningful things—but also make money! Qin Qing began actively exploring the panel’s potential. — Lin Feng was the captain of the Criminal Investigation Division in Wuning District. Ever since Qin Qing reported that wanted fugitive, their office had entered a golden period: human traffickers, dog traffickers, spies, criminal suspects… case after case seemed to resolve itself with surprising ease. The only thing worth pondering was: every single case somehow involved Qin Qing. Qin Qing: “Pure coincidence.” Lin Feng: “Isn’t the frequency of these ‘coincidences’ a bit too high?” Qin Qing: “Since you’ve figured it out, I won’t hide it anymore. Actually, I’m a master of metaphysics—commonly known as a fortune-teller.” Admit that she was using some unknown piece of black technology? Not a chance! Qin Qing became a young and well-known mystic, offering an incredibly wide range of services. From evaluating a restaurant chef’s cooking skill level to discover hidden food gems, to analyzing personal aptitude scores to help the lost find career direction—she even helped the police with their work on the side. Whenever someone questioned her, she would calmly reply: “Yes, I calculated it. I can even tell how many times you wet the bed as a kid—want to keep listening?”

title: Wilderness Survival Livestream Raised by Fluffy Beasts
description: Lin Qianyu, a top-tier player in the infinite survival game genre. She possesses exceptional combat skills and the ability to communicate with animals. After clearing all the game levels, she expected to return to the real world—only to accidentally transmigrate into a novel, becoming a cannon fodder side character with the same name who serves as a contrast to the heroine. To highlight the heroine’s excellence, this side character was written as someone who couldn’t tell grains apart, didn’t recognize wild plants, and acted dumb with a fake weak constitution. Apart from having a pretty face, she supposedly had no redeeming qualities. In the survival reality show, while everyone else worked hard to find food, this side character just sat and waited to be fed, backing off at the first sign of trouble—making the heroine, who bravely took the lead, seem courageous, resourceful, and hardworking. Lin Qianyu: “…” She transmigrated on the first day of the wilderness survival show. Viewers who had seen the preview flooded into the livestream chat with scorn: 【Lin Qianyu can’t lift a thing and is in poor health—won’t she just drag everyone down?】 【Just get off the show, ok?】 … The barrage of insults didn’t stop—until the livestream began. Lin Qianyu climbed trees to pick fruit, dove into the sea to fish, and casually knocked out a rabbit with a thrown stone. When she encountered a bear, she didn’t run—she petted it and even got honey as a tip. While the other guests were starving and delirious, Lin Qianyu roasted rabbit and chicken, drizzling them with honey. 【??? Whoever said Lin Qianyu is frail, step out here—now! If that’s frail, then what am I? Half-buried in a coffin?!】 【Doesn’t look like special effects. Let me keep watching.】 When they ran into poachers, Lin Qianyu knocked them down instantly—but then her “sickly” buff kicked in and she coughed up blood. Still, she wasn’t much affected and was ready to continue the fight. That’s when Feng Jingye rushed in, yanking Lin Qianyu behind him. Gripping the poacher’s throat with a dark expression, he growled, “You hit her?” The poacher, eyes swollen shut: “???” Dude—if you keep this up, I will call the cops! Lin Qianyu didn’t even look his way, just pointed at the black bear: “Go give him a couple slaps.” The black bear raised its paw and obliged. Livestream chat: 【…】 【Did I wake up too fast or did I just see a black bear slap someone?!】

title: I Tell Fortunes, You Eat Melons! My Merit Depends on You All
description: After waking up from a nap, Huo Ning-a grandmaster of the Mystic Arts-found herself transmigrated into the body of the Huo family’s eldest daughter, who had been kicked out of the house and saddled with massive debt. To pay it off, she started live-streaming fortune-telling sessions. – “Streamer, I’ve been haunted by a ‘Yin Peach Blossom’—a female ghost keeps cleaning my room and won’t let me order takeout!” Huo Ning twitched her lips. “Kid, stop overthinking it. That’s your mom.” – “Streamer, can you tell me if my idol’s future is bright and his career will flourish?” Huo Ning smiled. “Your idol is involved in casting couch scandals, tax evasion, drugs, gambling, you name it. He’s about to go to prison. Better unfollow him now.” – “Streamer, a certain tycoon built a tower in his late wife’s name to honor her. So touching!” Huo Ning rolled her eyes. “Oh, his wife died unjustly. That tower? He built it to suppress her spirit.” Then one day, her bankrupt s*umbag father showed up with her crippled, disfigured stepmother and stepsister, begging her to save them. Huo Ning smiled magnanimously. “I foresee your imminent demise. Let me live-stream a reading to predict your death dates.”

title: The Childless Emperor Has an Heir! The Court Officials Cheer, Grinning from Ear to Ear
description: On the day of the full moon banquet at the Prime Minister’s residence, the High Priest of the Jiuli Temple prophesied: the blooming of twin lotuses heralds misfortune for the Prime Minister’s household. Of the two daughters, one bears the fate of the Phoenix—destined to become the Mother of the Nation—while the other carries the curse of Solitary Calamity, doomed to bring disaster upon her kin. Qingli was born with the Celestial Eye, able to perceive all things in the world. Because of this, she was deemed to possess the Solitary Calamity fate. Barely a month old, she was cast off a cliff by her Father. By a stroke of fate, she was rescued by Qingmian, the Sect Master of the Seven Mystics Gate, who took her in as a personal disciple. He taught her cultivation and mystical arts, passed down the legacy of the sect, and protected her as she grew up safely. However, her destiny carried a tribulation—one that could only be overcome by the protection of Purple Qi. In order to obtain it, she drugged and seduced Nangong Yan, sharing a fleeting night with him. Afterward, she fled with a child in her womb. Three years later, she was declared dead.

title: Boss Fu, Your Wife Has Gone to Set Up a Fortune-Telling Stall Again… Again… and Again
description: After her master’s passing, mystical genius Lin Xi descends the mountain to make a living by setting up a fortune-telling stall—all while searching for her fiancé. Customer: “Master, when will my son’s destined true love appear?” Lin Xi: “There’s no true love destined for him—but a true husband, yes.” Customer: “Master, I’ve been dreaming of a ghost lately. Please exorcise it for me!” Lin Xi: “That ghost is your father. You visited the wrong grave, and he wants you to recognize the right one.” Customer: “Master, my mother has been missing for over twenty years.” Lin Xi: “Your father killed her and buried her in the backyard.” … The head of the Fu Corporation, a man known for being distant and indifferent to women, unexpectedly enters a flash marriage with a young fortune teller. Everyone keeps guessing when Boss Fu will get a divorce. But as they wait… the situation starts to shift in unexpected ways. Top celebrities cry and beg the little fortune teller for help! Influential figures are willing to pay fortunes just to meet her! Even the government reaches out, hoping to collaborate with her. People rush to book a session: “Master, I want a reading too!” One day, Lin Xi sets up her stall as usual. Fu Jingyao corners her against a wall: “Wife, read my fortune.” Lin Xi remains expressionless: “Working hours. I only talk business, not emotions.” Fu Jingyao pulls out all his bank cards: “All my money is yours.” Lin Xi’s eyes light up: “What do you want to know?” The man’s dark eyes glimmer with grievance as he murmurs: “Wife, when will we have our wedding night?” Lin Xi: “…” The man tightens his grip around her waist, his voice deep and husky: “Not answering? Then let’s make it tonight.” ________________________________________ (Genius Mystic Master × Super Wealthy Wife-Doting CEO. Arranged Marriage Turns to Love. Plot-Focused, with Various Mystical Subplots.)

title: I Rely on the Gossip System to Fake Being a Master [90s]
description: Gu Xicao transmigrated into a penniless orphan who illegally smuggled herself into Hong Kong during the 1990s. She has no money and is about to be kicked out, her only cheat is the Gossip System! Gu Xicao: “Don’t panic—watch me pull off a little trick.” In the extravagant and booming 1990s Hong Kong, where feng shui and fortune-telling runs deep across all classes, from humble workers to high-ranking officials, Gu Xicao made her grand entrance. She doesn’t need to divine fortunes or analyze faces—just give her a name, and she can see through your past, present, and future. “Miss Zhou, you lost your father as a child, your husband in middle age, and your son in old age. This is not a life of loneliness; it means you are destined for great success. The wise don’t fall into the trap of love—focus on building a better China.” Ms. Zhou, who had returned from studying abroad, was enlightened. She abandoned emotional entanglements, worked hard on her career, and rose as a shining star in the business world. “Mr. Wu, the bad news is your wife and your close friend are plotting against you—even trying to take your life. The good news is your ex-wife and daughter still care for you.” The big boss in the legal circle turned pale, immediately filed for divorce, and rushed to reconcile with his ex-wife, offering hundreds of millions in assets, leaving everyone in Hong Kong stunned. A serial killer terrorized the city, leaving citizens too afraid to go out at night. The police headquarters issued a strict deadline: the killer must be caught within three days. Yet Inspector Lin apprehended the criminal the very next morning. Facing reporters, he said: “Catching the killer was all thanks to Master Gu’s accurate calculations!” In an instant, Gu Xicao’s reputation soared, making her the top fortune-teller in Hong Kong. Countless newspapers featured her achievements, and high-ranking officials and the wealthy scrambled to get her contact information. Gu Xicao: “At first, I just wanted to make enough for the rent.”

title: Talent Show, Mystically Skyrocketing to Fame
description: The unfavored second young master of the Ke family, Ke Xingzhou, was finally brought back from the countryside—only because the Ke family had found their real second son and planned to kick him out. When they went to the countryside to pick him up, Ke Xingzhou was wearing a ragged Taoist robe, sunglasses with one missing arm, and was currently calculating how many kittens the neighbor’s orange tabby would give birth to—for 5 yuan—by pinching his fingers. When he heard why the Ke family came, he slapped his thigh: “You finally realized you picked up the wrong kid!” With how talented and brilliant he was, how could he possibly be the child of that dumb couple in the Ke family? Ke couple: ? Ke Xingzhou was a Taoist master. He had long known he wasn’t the real young master, so he moved out early and returned to the countryside. There, he lived a carefree life charming cats and dogs, catching ghosts, and telling fortunes. Until the real young master was found, and he was dragged onto a talent reality show as the “lazy, dumb foil” meant to make the real one look better by comparison. Ke Xingzhou looked disgusted. His adoptive parents: “Five million. From now on, we’ll have nothing more to do with each other—life, death, or sickness.” Ke Xingzhou instantly stood up: “Which way to the studio?” ** Ke Xingzhou brought his fortune-telling treasures to the show, planning to laze around until the end. But as soon as filming began, he saw a group of jinxed people with black clouds hanging over their heads walking in. Ke Xingzhou set up a stall on the spot: “Fortune telling? Groups of three, one gets a free reading.” At first, viewers said: “Superstition! Report him!” But later… people started to notice: Wait… it actually works?? After the livestream, Ke Xingzhou went viral. The once-hated “controversial celeb” got a full reputation makeover: The scandal-ridden rising star: “Thank you, Master Ke, for clearing my name!” The newly crowned Film Emperor: “Master Ke saved my life!” The washed-up director with a hit comeback: “I owe everything to Mr. Ke!” Soon, bigshots from all walks of life swarmed the little talent show just to get a reading from Ke Xingzhou. The most jaw-dropping moment? The rumored heir of a top wealthy family, Nie Chen, showed up on camera— cornered Ke Xingzhou against a wall and begged for a love reading. Ke Xingzhou, counting money, didn’t even look up: “Who are you? Don’t know you. No reading.” Nie Chen’s eyes darkened. He pulled out a bouquet made of 999 real estate title deeds: “Tell me—when will my ex finally take me back?” Ke Xingzhou’s eyes sparkled: “Now. Immediately!”

title: The False Daughter Descends the Mountain to Marry in Another’s Stead, While the True Master Seeks Nightly Divinations
description: The false heiress, Yu ning, descends the mountain to fulfill her master’s order and marry in another’s place. Rumor has it that her husband is in a vegetative state, the family is plagued with difficult elders, and four troublesome brothers-in-law are nothing but trouble. The entire elite circle waits eagerly for Yu ning’s downfall, while the true heiress laughs hysterically. In response, Yu ning declares that this is nothing to worry about. With her expertise in metaphysics, she can easily navigate the elite world. She reads fortunes, breaks formations, and resolves feng shui issues, winning the favor of all the elders. The four handsome brothers-in-law become her die-hard fans. The true heiress’s family regrets their actions and comes to confront her, only to be scratched all over by a fierce little black cat. Little Black Cat: Meow meow meow! (Stop pestering my wife, or I’ll bankrupt your entire family when I return to my own body!) Yu ning picks up the little black cat: Behave, don’t make a fuss. … After months of being in a vegetative state, CEO Lin awakens, with rumors circulating that the joyous influence of his petite wife was the cause. In response, CEO Lin sneers, “My wife is not just a petite beauty. She’s the head of metaphysics, a master fortune-teller, both beautiful and bold, with a slender waist and long legs. She can even uproot willow trees. Ning—dear wife, open the door! I genuinely seek a fortune-telling!” Yu ning: “At midnight, I don’t believe you genuinely want a fortune-telling.” CEO Lin: “Even seeking a child is still seeking a fortune.”

title: I Reached the Pinnacle of Life After Being Switched at Birth [Rebirth]
description: After being reborn, Ruan Bei knew that when he turned seventeen, his wealthy biological parents would come to take him home. Then, he would spend several years as a hated “outsider” in the Lu family, and repeatedly get involved in the relationship between the Lu family’s adopted son and his family. Eventually, he died from his involvement in one of those disputes. In this life, Ruan Bei just wants to make more money and help his parents live a good life. But… Does rebirth also come with the added bonus of opening one’s heavenly eyes? Ruan Bei, who was deathly afraid of ghosts, crumpled into a ball. Investment Boss Ghost: Want to make money? Help me send a love letter to my wife, and I’ll teach you how to trade stocks. Beauty lover: I can’t live without cosmetics! Burn me the best set of lipstick and I’ll give you all my jewelry. A past top scorer in the college entrance examination: Junior Brother, if you need private tutoring, just burn me the newest exercise books. It’s not fun if I don’t have any problems to solve. Ruan Bei: It turns out my rebirth isn’t my golden finger, these ghosts are. 🙂 Male Lead: No, I am. 🙂

title: Rich Side Character Goes Viral for Gossiping on a Laid-Back Reality Show
description: Yu Qianxia regains her past memories and discovers that she is merely a foil to the heroine in an entertainment industry novel. The female lead is her stepsister—gentle, kind, and easygoing. Meanwhile, as the eldest daughter of the Yu family, Yu Qianxia is notorious for being spoiled, reckless, and hot-tempered. Both of them join the same reality show. In the end, the heroine skyrockets to fame with her delicate and innocent persona, while Yu Qianxia gets buried under countless scandals, becoming the public’s least favorite. Her story ends in complete misery. Yu Qianxia wakes up and almost gets trapped by the plot. At that moment, a system voice suddenly rings in her mind: Yu Qianxia is thrilled: Is there such a good thing? Isn’t it just eating melons? I can do it! But she doesn’t expect that this melon-eating system has a bug—it makes her blurt out the truth from time to time. ⁕ Yu Qianxia joins the reality show Let’s Travel Together. The moment the show airs, netizens waste no time mocking her: “Oh great, the drama queen is back. Is she here to throw another diva tantrum?” “When will these resource-backed nobodies finally get kicked off the show?” Meanwhile, during filming, Yu Qianxia’s mind is suddenly flooded with all kinds of fresh celebrity gossip. Yu Qianxia eagerly eats up all the gossip, but at that moment, the system bug kicks in. She can’t hold back and blurts out to the top-tier singer, “Your kid’s already in kindergarten, and you still have the nerve to call yourself single?” To the actor, “Buying stamina supplements isn’t a crime, but I do feel bad for all your girlfriends.” To the female idol, “Raking in money with lip-syncing—do your fans know about this?” Netizens: !!! Later, they discover that everything Yu Qianxia says is true! All those melons get exposed! Soon, Yu Qianxia realizes that celebrities in the industry start avoiding her, and even the heroine doesn’t dare to get close to her. Netizens cheer, calling her the melon eater with a soul dedicated to spilling tea. A massive crowd gathers behind Yu Qianxia, eagerly devouring every juicy scandal she uncovers. Her popularity skyrockets, and she becomes an overnight sensation. But what Yu Qianxia never expects… is that an even bigger melon is waiting for her to uncover! Yu Qianxia’s eyes light up. “Spill, who is it?!” After eating the melon, Yu Qianxia suddenly blurts out, “What? It’s Yu Qianxia!” Yu Qianxia: Huh??
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: The Metaphysics Master Returns to the Capital: A Single Calculation Makes Officials Tremble
description: Xiao Anle climbed out of a mass grave with only one month left to live. If she wants to extend her life, she needs to earn virtue—and this just happens to be her specialty. She has no memory of her original body, but it turns out she’s a high-born daughter of a government official. When a delicate, sickly white lotus girl falsely accuses her of causing her illness, Anle opens her mother’s “Heavenly Eye” once. “Mother, look—those two ghostly maids were the real culprits, not me. But I can help send them off peacefully… for an extra fee.”Her mother nearly fainted on the spot. Her eldest brother brought home a sinister entity that feeds on his life energy.With one talisman, the ghost reveals its true form. Her warrior brother’s legs went weak—turns out ghosts are real after all. Her second brother, brave and bold, wants to marry a ghost bride. Anle kindly opens his “Heavenly Eye”:“Second Brother, look—a skeleton in makeup. That pretty bride of yours doesn’t have a face. Want me to break the curse? That’ll cost more.”Second Brother: “…Thanks, I guess.” Her proper and studious third brother gets cursed during his civil exam prep—no toilet paper when he needs it, his hair falls out in the wind. That one’s too easy. Her youngest sister falls for a poor scholar. Anle, out of kindness, lets her see the ghostly mother and child following him.“Little Sister, your scholar’s not a good guy!” One day, Xiao Anle approaches the rumored God of War, the terrifying imperial uncle—Every second she stands near him earns her a merit point. She could lie down and gain virtue, but no—she insists on working hard. Soon, everyone in the capital is living in fear, clutching their blankets.Wherever this young lady goes, misfortune follows.“Oh great War God Prince, please take your Princess Consort home and don’t let her out again!” P.S.: A bit silly, humorous, and full of shenanigans. If you don’t get it, please don’t leave a bad review—thank you!

title: Her Fortune-Telling Was Too Accurate, She Accidentally Became a National Treasure
description: Chu Zhimeng, the darling daughter of the Heavenly Dao, spent every day indulging in food, fun, and leisure without a care in the world. Eventually, the Heavenly Dao couldn’t take it anymore and threw her into a world where evil outweighed good. She became the only daughter of the Chu family — the real daughter they had lost and recovered. Her parents were dead, leaving behind three older brothers and a lonely her. After looking through the original host’s memories, Chu Zhimeng had only one reaction: Tragic! Tragic! Tragic! The original host’s only wish? To sever ties with her brothers. Chu Zhimeng: Wish granted. Leaving the Chu family with no money, no savings, and a long list of missions to complete, Chu Zhimeng decided to start livestreaming to support herself. She figured she might as well earn money while completing tasks — two birds with one stone. Netizens: “A master? This cute little girl can’t possibly be a real master. She must be a fraud.”Cue the smell of regret later. Netizen: “Master, help! There’s a ghost trying to kill me!”Chu Zhimeng (sipping milk tea): “Your grandfather’s grave was dug up and you didn’t even know? Of course he’s coming after you.” Netizen: “Streamer, I want a passionate yet sweet romance!”Chu Zhimeng (slurping instant noodles): “With your brother around, forget about sweet. Passionate? Maybe.” Netizen: “Master, my chickens keep dying one after another. Is there something dirty in my house?”Chu Zhimeng (sipping watermelon juice): “No. But you should go check your basement.” As Chu Zhimeng’s life kept getting better and better, her brothers were full of regret.Unfortunately, the familial bond between them had already been severed.

title: Universal Chat Group: The Real Heiress Makes Billions and Becomes a Sensation
description: Su Qian accidentally joins a mysterious chat group — and to her shock, she’s the only one who hasn’t transmigrated! Su Qian:… And so begins Su Qian’s new life — exchanging resources and getting rich beyond belief. * Rice, flour, oil, and bottled water are traded with apocalyptic transmigrators for gold, silver, and jewels. * Fried chicken, milk tea, and hotpot are traded with cultivation realm transmigrators for beauty and rejuvenation pills. * Mahjong, snacks, and Empresses in the Palace (TV series) are traded with ancient transmigrators for royal jewelry. Cultivator Transmigrator: “Help! I think I accidentally sent my master over to you in our last trade!” Su Qian: ?!! She quietly glances at the man munching on fried chicken and sipping milk tea. He’s kinda hot. Should I send him back or keep him? About the Author: Shi Dou Bao A (是豆包啊) is a talented author known for captivating storytelling and richly detailed writing. Works like Multiverse Chat Group: The Real Heiress Makes Billions and Becomes a Sensation are beloved for their twists, humor, and strong pacing.

title: Live-Stream Fortune Telling: Dare to Mess with Me, I’ll Close the Door and Release the Ghosts!
description: She is Su Ran, the most respected and esteemed master of metaphysics—the favorite disciple of the grandmaster in the field. After battling a toad demon for three hundred rounds and winning, her soul suddenly transmigrates into another world—into the body of a girl who fell into a sewer. Oh my god, who’s life is worse than mine? To make ends meet and have a meal every day, she starts live-streaming fortune telling. Three readings a day, five hundred per reading. Su Ran: “Ice cream or dad? Which one do you choose?”Viewer: “Choose dad? Fine, then the ice cream is mine.” A lucky baby: “Host, can you tell if the baby in my belly is a boy or a girl?”Su Ran’s expression suddenly changes: “Forget boy or girl—run for your life!” A beautiful young lady, looking pale: “Host, I have anemia.”Su Ran clicks her tongue: “That’s not anemia, you’re being drained by a vampire!” A newly rich man named “The God of Wealth’s Little Treasure”: “Host, I think I just dug up a zombie?”Su Ran sincerely remarks: “You’ve got great luck—go buy a lottery ticket!” A handsome guy: “Host, there’s nothing for you to tell me.”Su Ran: “Nothing to tell? Your sister’s mango allergy almost killed her!” …and so on.

title: No Feeding the NPC Cub! [Infinite]
description: Gu Rong is a two-year-old zombie toddler. Because he’s so tiny, his little legs can’t carry him fast enough to catch any prey, leaving him with an empty tummy every day. Prey would practically stroll right under his nose, and just as he’d try to scramble up to chase them, thud – he’d faceplant. Then, Gu Rong wakes up to find he’s been transported into a horror game, becoming the smallest NPC in the whole thing. NPCs make their living by scaring players, but Gu Rong is just too darn cute. His soft, squishy appearance isn’t scary at all. Players take one look at this miniature NPC, do a double-take, and then completely melt! Gu Rong wraps his arms around a player’s leg, tiny fists pummeling their shin in what feels more like a tickle: “Gonna get you, gonna get you!” A player offers him a dried fish snack. Gu Rong clutches the little fish and gobbles it down with gusto, making happy “mmm” sounds. Believing he’s earning his food by scaring players, Gu Rong sets off on a path of, well, terrifying (read: endearing) the players to death. The little zombie cub hops and skips, but he can’t even jump over a measly twenty-centimeter “chasm.” The poor kiddo has to take a detour, going a whole hundred meters out of his way. By the time he gets there, the player has effortlessly hopped across. The little zombie keeps hopping, and after an hour, he’s so hungry he’s hopping and wiping away tears with his tiny hands. A player rushes over and scoops up the little zombie. They dig into their own pockets, using their points to redeem a huge bag of food for the little cub. Player: “Okay, okay, I’ll just come to you so you can scare me, how about that?” The player even coaches the little guy on how to be scary: “Good, good, hold that pose. You’re already, like, two percent scary.” Players enter the game, all eagerly waiting for the little cub to pop out and “scare” them. Players, loaded down with piles of snacks and drinks, sit waiting: “Why isn’t he out yet?” Livestream chat: “This is a horror game! You’re supposed to be beating levels, not feeding the NPC cub!” Audience: “Form an orderly line, please! No shoving, no fighting, and absolutely no junk food!” Whenever a player shares the screen with the little cub, their livestream viewership explodes. Players: “You’re here to watch us beat the game, not to watch this little guy!” But later… A player is trying to complete a task, and the audience is having none of it: “What are you even doing? We want to see the cub! Show us the cub!” The player, down to their last sliver of health and about to die: “…” “You guys don’t care about me at all, do you?!” Players gradually realize that the more they’re on screen with the little cub, the more viewers they get. They’ve instantly cracked the code for getting views. Now, every player who enters the game starts actively searching for the cub, eagerly volunteering to be “scared,” and, of course, showering him with all sorts of tasty treats and drinks. The little cub, who used to be constantly hungry, is now plump and round, like a little dumpling. He still believes he’s so scary that players are willingly offering him food. The little cub screws up his face in a “scary” grimace and toddles off to “terrify” another player, letting out a ferocious roar: “Rawr!”

title: Salted Fish Cub is the Team Pet in an Unlimited Game
description: Gu Lin is an auspicious beast cub, not even two years old, who transmigrated into a horror game. He wobbles when he walks. Both the other players and the livestream audience are stunned: “Holy crap, someone this small is a player? Is the system broken?” Are we sure this isn’t the parenting channel? A kid this tiny, wouldn’t the ghosts just gobble him up, several at a time?! Because the little cutie is so ridiculously adorable, he regularly makes the livestream audience squeal. The players also scramble to hold him, their hearts aching as they watch him struggle to walk. But, unexpectedly, this little cub gets first place every single time?! Mermaid Town: Disguised as a mermaid, Gu Lin turns into a little merman cub, inching forward slowly. Because he’s so lazy, he doesn’t even crawl a meter in half an hour, and eventually just lies down on a blanket and falls asleep. Livestream: …I…I want to adopt one QAQ Because he wants to get the little pearls that are formed from mermaid tears, Gu Lin challenges a mermaid gege to a crying contest. But after a long time, his stomach is rumbling, and the other guy still hasn’t cried. Gu Lin bursts into tears first, wiping his eyes with his little hands: “I don’t want to play with you anymore!” The mermaid gege coaxes and hugs him, resignedly going to find him some little pearls. Psychiatric Hospital: Gu Lin plays the youngest mental patient. Even the doctor NPC retracts his fangs and turns gentle, asking him why he’s here. The cub says: “Gege has nothing to eat, so I wanted to cook myself for him. Gege said I’m sick. I told him that if he boils me a few times, it’ll kill the germs, but he doesn’t believe me.” Doctor: !! The cub hangs his little head sadly: “When I’m cured, gege can eat me, right?” Doctor: …?! No, that’s still not okay. Livestream:

title: Game Loading
description:
Xie Xi was someone with luck off the charts! The advantage was that any game could be easily cleared. The disadvantage was that all games were boring! Then one day, the words ‘Game loading’ appeared in front of his eyes and he began to clear real games! The emperor of luck ran into a bottleneck in the first game. Game Name: Love to the Left or Right The vampire prince has invited you to a meal. Will you go? Xie Xi: I won’t go. Arrow through the heart. The vampire prince says you can’t leave him and takes your life. After loading the file, Xie Xi changed the option: I will go. The housekeeper has cut off your head because of love and hatred. Xie Xi: ???
Reader:?????

title: Welcome to the Nightmare Game
description: Qi Leren had just cleared the bad ending of «The Nightmare Games» when his laptop died well before its time. His luck seemed to follow him as he was transported, along with the other passengers, to a hospital following an accident between his bus and a truck. Upon waking in a transfusion hall rather than a ward, QiLeren felt a familiar sense of dread as he took in the hospital that held no trace of other people… Book 1 of a Tetralogy

title: Welcome to the Nightmare Game II
description: Just as Qi Leren received the first BE ending of “Nightmare Game”, he had the bad luck of his computer screen going black. While taking a bus to get it repaired, he had the bad luck of the bus colliding with a truck, and the injured passengers were taken to the hospital. When he woke up, Qi Leren found that he was lying in an empty fusion hall, and there was no one else in the huge hospital… … … … Seven days later, Qi Leren opened his eyes. Book 2 of a Tetralogy

title: Escape From the Library
description: One day late at night, Yue Xingwen went to the library to check out some information, and as soon as he entered the door, he heard a cold mechanical sound ringing in his ears — Welcome to the ‘Escape From the Library’ real-life survival game. Library rules: 1.  Credits can be obtained for each clearance, and the credits can be exchanged for field of study-related skill books or props; 2. Each department has a different subject course; 3. If you can’t pass the course, you will be obliterated! The library was full of crises. In order to escape their life, the students trapped in the library crossed the sea with eight immortals and showed their remarkable abilities— Department of Chemistry’s schoolmate: Acid, base, salt, chemical reaction melt everything! Department of Physics’ classmate: Light, electricity, spring, magnetic field, gravity, the demons and ghosts stay away from me! Department of Medicine’s senior: Scalpel, surgical suture, medical gauze, what the hell with pulling out the electric chainsaw? A student from the Department of Biological Science can do mitosis to directly split himself into countless numbers? The senior sister from the Department of Environment can plant trees on the spot, and the junior brother from the Department of Architecture can dig a hole in the ground to make tunnels… Department of Chinese Language and Literature’s protagonist: Don’t panic! Conveniently taking out a copy of “Modern Idioms Dictionary. ” Schoolmates: ….??? This escape team is getting stranger and stranger.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: The Villain Loaded My System
description: Gu Xiyu led a task. He needed to go to few small worlds to solve the villains whose dangerous index exceeded the standard, so that the world can restore it’s harmony and beauty. It’s just that, the system sent to him was a bit strange. The first sentence it used to greet him was– “Who are you?” In the beginning, Gu Xiyu thought this was a super-intelligent humanized system newly developed by the Administration. Later he felt that his system was sick. In order to fight for sovereignty, the powerful villains will hurt the protagonist. Gu Xiyu thought he would receive an order to stop him with a knife to the villain. The system said, “You send him a bunch of flowers and he may not deal with the protagonist when he is in a good mood.” In order to destroy the empire, the general villain of the empire will severely wound the protagonist prince. System instruction: “If you act cute to him, he may accept your request and not exterminate the human race.” The great demon of the cultivation world captures all kinds of immortal cultivation pills to increase his energy. The system said: “In fact, there is another way for villain to progress.” “Such as?” “Practice dual cultivation with the villain.” Gu Xiyu:? Because he would be punished for refusing the order, he could only act according to the order. Surprisingly, the progress bar for the reduction of world danger actually moved. But the villain was getting more and more wrong.

title: Happy Doomsday
description: Genius scientist Ruan Xian was in a coma for several years. Once he opened his eyes, his waist no longer felt pain, his legs had healed, and he could jump around. Unfortunately, the artificial intelligence outside ran out of control and ushered in the end of mankind. Fortunately, his luck was still strong, and he successfully captured a partner with great survival skills. Tang Yibu: Our models are old and especially easy to scrap. Tang Yibu: Remember, the first principle of safety. Never get too close to humans. Ruan Xian: ……What? This is a story about a dumb AI x a cynical scientist.

title: The Easter Egg Game
description: Book 1 On the day he received the Easter Egg, Lin Jue’s entire life changed. That nightmarish night, everyone in the school became zombies apart from the thirteen who had received an easter egg. It wasn’t because of a deadly virus, but rather a cruel game. Unable to leave the school, they were able to find a bargaining chip for life in the plaza. The prowling hunters in the dark were not the most fearsome opponents, the hidden Judas in the survivors was the most deadly. As everyone died one by one, the survivors struggled, waiting for dawn. Book 2 It was a nightmare- in a sealed off university campus, the thirteen who received easter eggs were trapped and forced to fight for the sake of seeing the next sunrise. The Judas hidden among the players, the enemies that surrounded them on all fronts, the companions that were ready to turn against each other… When Lin Jue woke up on his dormitory bed, there were no wounds on his body; everything from the previous night had just seemed like a dream. But Lilith was still giving out her easter eggs, and Song Hanzhang and Lu Ren were already there. The second round was just about to start. It turned out that all of it, all of it was real. Book 3 “It means that the world we are in now is fake.” That one sentence from Song Hanzhang woke Lin Jue up from the joy he felt from surviving the second round. From the moment they received the easter eggs, they had stopped existing in the world of men, and been made to struggle to survive in an endless game. The zombies of the first round, the insects of the second round; every round resulted in piles of casualties in this dangerous world. And in the third round… they were faced with an unprecedented, terrifying crisis. A team from 2002 and a team from 2022 began a battle of life and death with Lin Jue and the others from the 2012 team. Only one could survive, so who would be the real winner?

title: Transmigrated into the Film Emperor’s Death-Seeking Fiance
description: His filming opportunities were taken by others; his boyfriend cheated on him; he gave up a rich, tall handsome fiance and devoted himself to a s*umbag. In the end, he was beaten to death by the s*umbag. Yan Qing Chi felt that although this danmei cannon fodder supporting male that he transmigrated into was troublesome, it was kind of tragic that he died like this through his own actions. So, the first thing that Yan Qing Chi did after taking over this body was to catch them in the act and beat up the s*umbag! The second thing that he did, was to agree to the marriage proposal from the aristocratic fiance. However, Yan Qing Chi stared down at his big belly. Who can tell him what the heck this was?! Don’t tell him that he transmigrated into a mpreg novel??? Standing on the side, the tall, rich, and handsome Film Emperor Jiang asked carefully, “Babe, do you want a boy or a girl?” Yan Qing Chi: Do I want a WHAT?!
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: The Mad Dog First Love
description: “After Hyung disappeared, he was erased from everyone’s memory.” 68 years ago, Kim Shibaek crash-landed in the otherworldly realm of ‘Mach Slecht’ and suddenly found himself returning to Korea. Upon his return, he is reunited with a younger brother, Taewoon, whom he had cherished as a child. For Shibaek, only 21 years had passed on Earth since his disappearance. However, during that time, the world was overrun by monsters, and people began awakening supernatural abilities. Among the most famous of these awakened hunters is Taewoon, an S-rank hunter and the notorious leader of the Seven Guild, known for his bad-tempered and eccentric personality. “Why does he look so worn out…? My little Woonie used to smell like sunshine when he stood still and like milk when he toddled around. His chubby cheeks were so soft and plump, and he was so small and cute….” But Taewoon, who is still adorable in Shibaek’s eyes, tells him a shocking truth before Shibaek can even adjust to life on Earth: Taewoon is the only one who remembers Shibaek, even though he was once an Olympic gold medalist. While searching for a way to return to Mach Slecht, a system window suddenly appears before Shibaek, throwing him into a series of critical quests. However, Shibaek hesitates to complete the quest, and the system informs him that only by preventing Earth’s destruction will he discover how to return to Mach Slecht…?

title: Ghosts Know What I Experienced
description: Ever since he was little, Xi Jia’s yin energy was strong, so every day he saw and ran into ghosts. One day, he accidentally broke the protection amulet. Celestial Master Ye Jingzhi happened to pass by and helped. Are ghost catching Celestial Masters all legit masters? WeChat official accounts, Taobao online shops, looking at gossip tabloids every day. Since then, Xi Jia has refreshed the lower limit again and again, and met a group of completely unreliable Celestial Masters. Binding spirits, doppelgängers, the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, the ghost market of Poyang… The door to a new world is slowly opening.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: I Rely on Kisses to Clear Survival Games
description: Cheng Zhi Chu was pulled into an infinite stream of horror games. If he didn’t clear them, he would die. But can someone tell him why others clear the games using violence and force but his method of clearing the game is by kissing the boss?! Cheng Zhi Chu: I am a straight man. Even if I kill myself or am killed by monsters, I will not kiss the boss! Boss: Be good. Kiss me and I’ll let you go. Bai Yi had been trapped in the game for many years. Rather than exploding in anger in the silence, he had turned crazy. And so…….he split himself. His soul was broken into many pieces and each of them became the boss in the games. But, regardless of how the soul was split, from the beginning to the end there was one thing that didn’t change —–He, likes Cheng Zhi Chu. Every fragment of his soul was utterly in love with him. It was also because of this that he and every fragment of his couldn’t stand seeing people other than himself getting close to Cheng Zhi Chu —- Even if the other party used to be a part of himself. Dark desire gradually surged inside him. Anyone who gets between him and Cheng Zhi Chu——even if it’s himself —– he would kill them all. “The person who you should really kiss……is me.”

title: Let’s Meet Alive
description: A zombie virus has spread in peaceful Seoul. Korea has named zombies ‘Meogbo/Eaters’, and after a struggle, they fail to eradicate the meogbo. – Fellow Koreans, on September 30, our government and Seoul decided to give up the Korean Peninsula. – Come to Jeonnam. – The military is waiting at Mokpo Port, Mokpo, Jeollanam-do. – Fellow citizens. Let’s all meet alive. Shin-hu: a blunt bodyguard from special forces. Tae-baek: a boss who is playful and has a cold face with a weak stomach . Tae-baek to live, Shin-hu to save Tae-baek, Together, the two navigate a world of chaos. “If you think your life will be in jeopardy while saving me, then leave me. I don’t want to go there.” Tae-baek, who tried to speak calmly, “I won’t leave you alone. No matter what happens, I won’t leave.” Shin-hu responded with his distinctive calm tone. The two grow closer as they spend time together. Tae-baek discovers the tenderness hidden in Shin-hu’s indifference, Shin-hu soaks in Tae-baek’s reckless affection. “Do you like me? I think I will fall in love in a few days. I get that feeling.” “…” “And maybe, you will love me too.” Tae-baek proudly confesses his love, while smiling like a boy who had just started his first love. Shin-hu chuckles without answering. ‘Eaters’ flocked around these two. Don’t die, don’t give up, Let’s all meet alive.

title: Nirvana Rebirth
description: In the tides of time, humankind has lost their position as the wisest of all creatures. The Steel City that suddenly rose in the center of the eastern lands and a man-made god, ‘Father,’ have replaced them. Mechs have taken over the world of this petri dish, Astrolabe, that the ancient Creators have left behind. One day, a young human s*ave named A-Ka finds a black-haired male on a beach of Desolate Sea… The world of Astrolabe is about to reboot, so what will become of the future of the humans, androids, and mechs?

title: Non-Human Seeking Re-employment
description: Shen Dongqing was a powerful, thousand-year-old ferocious ghost. He had just possessed a body and barely managed to relax for two days when he was pulled into a world where hundreds of ghosts were running amok. On the first day of being pulled into the Infinite Nightmare Game: Other players were trembling, crying and wailing about wanting to go home. Shen Dongqing was eating, sleeping, and playing Fight the Landlord (card game). The second day: Other players were covering their heads and scurrying away like frightened rats as they were being chased by ghosts, and they were crying out loud for help. Shen Dongqing was eating, sleeping and playing Fight the Landlord. The third day. Shen Dongqing…… The ghosts finally set their sights on this lazy player. The other players were finding joy in his misfortune, but in the end, no one had expected that the slim and pale Shen Dongqing would throw down his phone and directly dispatch the ghosts with his bare hands. Other ghosts: Can’t afford to mess with him, move, move.
filtered_tags: Love Interest Falls in Love First

title: Looting Equipment From NPCs
description: Lou Fan is an ordinary person, nothing special. However, after being suddenly drawn into the mission world, he found himself quite special—very lucky to be exact! When other people’s whole team is destroyed, his team passed with everyone intact; other people can’t find equipment, they get rewards from NPC; other people’s spirit weapons are used as decorations, while their spirit weapons leveled up like a rocket. Lou Fan: Although I’m lucky, my strength is terrible… Qin Tan: I will never waste time talking rubbish if I can just take action. Alright, who of you is my opponent? NPC: No! We just want to kneel down and call Dad! This terrifying lucky king not only robs players of equipment, but the important thing is that he doesn’t even let go of NPCs!!! A violent but unlucky guy and a weak but lucky king teaming up, the NPCs decided to resign. They couldn’t do this job!

title: Unlimited Cycles of Death
description: Six strangers met in a mysterious, enclosed space. Amongst them, one of them claimed to be a “senior” and stated that there was a cold-blooded “ghost” among them who kills without batting an eye. How can they escape the pursuit of the “ghost” and escape from this world, this is the greatest problem they are faced with. Mu Qin: I have a person I really like. He’s a great person. He always likes to hold a knife and dance in front of me. But one day, he went crazy.

title: Zombie University
description: Song Fei’s university life was nothing special. He took his compulsory courses, skipped his elective courses, and took the CET-4 and CET-6. If he had to point out one thing that was bothering him, it’d be his “bad penny”, academic tyrant ex-boyfriend— Qi Yan. As the saying goes, exes, like villains, are hard to raise: too close and they’re impertinent; too far, then there’s resentment. He thought his university life would pass by uneventfully just like this, until that day, when an infected classmate rushed into the examination hall… The zombie virus spread like wildfire. All communication was cut. Campus turned into hell. No one knew what the outside world was like. And no one knew if they should “persevere and wait for rescue” or “break through the heavy encirclement”. Song Fei chose the latter. Qi Yan actually became a comrade-in-arms. Without the power to exterminate everything in sight, without a martial arts expert’s physique, on this once familiar campus, they can only rely on their own knowledge and tenacity to fight for survival!

title: To Be a Heartthrob in a Horror Movie
description: Holographic viewing technology allowed audience members to enter a movie and personally experience it for themselves. Naturally, romance movies were the most popular and well-received, while nobody was interested in horror movies. Su Min was the first of the viewers to experience a horror movie. Later– Malicious Spirit: I dare not scare nor frighten my sweetheart… Su Min: Actually, horror movies aren’t scary at all. Audience: No, no, no, you are playing in a romance movie! (Loudly) The audience suddenly discovered that the recent rerelease of the horror movie was much better than the original. Furthermore, to everyone’s surprise, the ghost was very sweet…

title: Stealing The Wind But Not The Moon
description: In the spring of 1945, Shen Ruozhen, a patriotic banker, secretly sent out the last batch of anti-coins and closed Fuhua Bank. However, during the safe transfer, his ship was shipwrecked. As he lost consciousness, he thought he was going to die. Later, he heard someone talking beside him, reciting a pair of elegiac couplets. When he opened his eyes, he found himself lying in a 21st century advanced ward. There was a handsome but indifferent stranger sitting by his bedside. “Who are you?” Shen Ruozhen asked. “Don’t you remember me?” the stranger replied. “I don’t know you,” Shen Ruozhen said. “Chu Zhichen, it’s no use pretending to have amnesia after such a big accident,” the stranger said. Shen Ruozhen was confused. He had never heard of Chu Zhichen before. But as he looked at the stranger’s face, he felt a sense of familiarity. —— “Seems I’m…” Shen Ruozhen coughed, a wet, rattling sound that tore at Xiang Mingzhang’s heart. “Breaking my promise…” “No!” he roared, his voice thick with denial. “We promised to live together! You’re a man of your word, Shen Ruozhen. You can’t break it now!” “This year…” he rasped, his voice barely audible. “Happiest year of my life…” “Hold on,” he pleaded, his voice cracking. “Don’t leave me, Ruozhen, don’t leave me.” ——

title: Quickly Wear the Face of the Devil
description: A top hacker was chosen by the Lord God to be reborn into countless worlds, always as an expendable villain. With no free will, every world became a dead end. Each of his lives ended tragically. Finally, after wrestling control of the Villain System, this ace hacker decided to enact revenge. Even if his very bones were rotten, he’d choose to occupy the very heights of morality, if only on the surface. Thus, he would change his fate as an ab*sed slag.

title: Mr. Melancholy Wants to Live a Peaceful Life
description: Yu Hua loses his job, and the weight of the household falls on the shoulders of his partner, You Zhengping. His husband is a temporary employee at the subdistrict office, with a monthly salary of only 2500; this troubles Yu Hua exceedingly. You Zhengping is secretly engaged in the work of protecting the world from Destroyers, with a rather liberal subsidy. You Zhengping spends all day fretting: how can he tell Yu Hua that he has a few million in private savings without giving anything away? Right up until the day that You Zhengping receives a notice that a power great enough to destroy the world has appeared in his home. Worried that something will happen to Yu Hua, an ordinary person, You Zhengping hurries home with his team. Once through the door, he sees a peaceful home, Yu Hua wearing an apron, a lifted frying pan in his hand, and a fish, golden on both sides and its aroma wafting around, frying in the pan. Seeing You Zhengping, Yu Hua puts the frying pan on the switched-off electric stove and wipes his hands on his apron. “I wanted to save on the electricity bill.” You Zhengping: … The entire world’s most awesome Destroyer is his husband.

title: Hunter, Thank You For Your Blood Donation!
description:
With the advancement of science, human life has changed dramatically. And such changes have also affected not only humans but also ‘non-human beings’. “Hello, this is Vampi the vampire. I mainly play horror games on weekdays. On weekends, I do casual broadcasts and chat with viewers who volunteer for blood donations.” Siwol is a half-vampire who has lived for hundreds of years. A 21st-century customized streamer vampire who pretends to be a vampire and streams horror games, sustaining his life by receiving blood donations from volunteers. “Your precious blood saves a poor unfortunate vampire! I usually only accept volunteers via email, but today I will accept volunteers through chat as well. Why? Because I’m really thirsty….” Then one day. To Siwol, who hadn’t drunk blood in a long time and was starving. I would like to volunteer for blood donation.]
[Thank you, ‘Hunter’, for donating 1,000,000 won! I have to leave Korea soon. I think this is my last chance, so I ask you.]
[Thank you, ‘Hunter’, for donating 5,000,000 won! Is it really not possible?]
“Yes….. you can come. I mean, please come.”
A viewer with a nickname he has never seen before generously donates and volunteers for blood donation, and Siwol, who is blinded by blood rather than money, readily invites him to his home.
But why does this ‘Hunter’-nim seem suspicious?

“Cough, cough! ….. Y-You want my autograph?”
“That’s what I came here for.”

Siwol is uncontrollably swayed by his assertiveness.
The viewer with the nickname ‘Hunter’ makes a dangerous proposition to Siwol…..

title: Only Fools Believe in Love
description: Zhang Yuze fell asleep only to find out that he had crossed over into a random book… Becoming a s*um gong’s pitiful but cheap ex-boyfriend, someone who even turned into a love-obsessed stalker after being rejected. As for Xu Li, the original s*um gong, he was simply disappointed with love and marriage after witnessing his father’s domestic violence and the breakdown of his parent’s marriage. On top of that, he was also a firm believer in a famous saying: Only fools believe in love. * One would think that Zhang Yuze would be happy to hold the script, eager to stage a cool drama about tearing up a s*umbag, hitting him with a counterattack, and forcing him to chase his wife through a crematorium, right? Unfortunately, no. Because he himself also didn’t believe in love. Zhang Yuze, the one who once experienced the betrayal of his first love, being played with and forced to wear a green hat, actually agreed with the s*umbag… Only fools believe in love. * He thought that there would be no more intersections between his and Xu Li’s life. But who knew that one day, Xu Li, who had a high fever, suddenly stretched out his hand to him, looking provocative and frivolous. He swallowed an antipyretic and suddenly said: “You don’t believe in love, and neither do I. However, medicine says that practice comes from true knowledge. How about we fall in love and see if there’s such a thing?” * “Do you believe in love?” “No, I don’t.” “Then why are we getting married?” “I don’t need love, but I need you.” The one with the most poisonous tongue in the world, Zhang Yuze vs. The drama dog with a coquettish mouth, Xu Li. Reversible couple! Mutual attack story!

title: Hello, How Long Has This Been Going On?
description: Programmer Tao Zhiyue transmigrated into a dogblood CEO novel as a cannon fodder. He was the first love of the protagonist Huo Ran that caused the latter to become disabled and brokenhearted, and was later killed by the protagonist’s husband in an extremely tragic manner. Without any hesitation, Tao Zhiyue ran away. Living as a homebody otaku, he firmly stayed put at home with his computer as company, becoming addicted to the online world of idiots, living unhappily. Just kidding, even if the plot wanted him to run into the one surnamed Huo, there were no opportunities, okay? One day, while scrolling through the forums, he came across a far-fetched phishing post: Gay man who has been single since birth Tao Zhiyue sneered and replied— After a few minutes. Tao Zhiyue: ? He then inexplicably made a boomer-like internet friend. Tao Zhiyue tried giving his straight male internet friend some coquettish ways of rejecting his pursuers and ended up with significant results, successfully quashing the other parties’ loves! Later on, the internet friend with whom his relationship was growing more ambiguous by the day invited him to meet formally in real life, and he arrived at the meeting with an excited heart. The tall and handsome man nervously extended a hand towards him, blushing: Hello, my name is Huo Ran. Tao Zhiyue: !!!!!! * Firm-hearted programmer shou who loves living and will never work overtime X Occasionally immature, pure, and straightforward second generation wealth gong, double first love

title: My Husband is Suffering from a Terminal Illness
description: Xie Yang struggled in the post-apocalyptic world for many years until he was too tired to go on. Then he transmigrated into a young adult entertainment circle novel where the protagonists have easy, sweet, and satisfying lives. The male protagonist of the novel is not just handsome and smart, he’s also reborn. The female protagonist of the novel is not only beautiful and works hard towards her dreams, she also has a cheat in her hands. There’s a lot of male and female supporting roles, each having pretty face, nice figures and someone strong behind them. Get into any one of their bodies, and he could close his eyes and just enjoy life. But he didn’t. Instead he transmigrated into a young idol secretly married to the biggest villain of all — the male protagonist’s maternal uncle. His title is husband but it’s more like a nurse. Because this novel’s biggest villain is a terminally ill patient who is gloomy and sick in the head (actually sick). Their marriage was to counter the bad luck (illness). Xie Yang: Who cares if you’re the male lead, female lead, male supporting, female supporting, villain or protagonist. Get in the way of my comfortable life and you’ll die (: Also titled: [Daily life of husbands trading blows] – [If you love me, let’s divorce] – [Crazy gong: I’ll never divorce]

title: Assassin Bride
description: Cove’s Raven, the assassin Gio. After presenting as an omega, he is given a final, dangerous mission: Assassinate Grand Duke Bayshark—the only ultra-dominant alpha in the empire, cousin to the Emperor, and the feared monster of the North. Disguised as a bride, Gio attempts to poison him on their wedding night— But instead, he is caught… and offered a new proposal: “The Emperor sent you to marry me. Don’t you think it’s your duty as a loyal subject to make it look like a happy marriage? Just become my bride, assassin.” A command to pose as the fake Grand Duchess, fooling the Emperor’s eyes. Pretending to be a loving newlywed, performing with poise in high society— It’s unlike any mission he’s taken before. But that’s fine. Gio has always completed every assignment perfectly.

title: Guan Shan Yue
description: The Dandy Prince x The Cold and Abstinent General.

title: The Substitute Awakens
description: Yan Heqing awakens. One second before signing the substitute contract. It turns out he was a substitute cannon fodder in a book. In the story, he served as Lu Muchi’s substitute for Bai Yueguang for three years. He was slapped by Lu Muchi’s little lover he held in his arms, sent by Lu Muchi to seduce a competitor and almost forced, and had his neck choked by Lu Muchi almost to death. He l**ked and groveled willingly, enjoying it, and fell deeply in love with Lu Muchi. In the end, he voluntarily donated his eyes to exchange for Lu Muchi’s Bai Yueguang—his twin brother’s brightness. He and his twin brother were abandoned and sent to an orphanage since childhood. He gave up the opportunity to be adopted by a wealthy family for his brother, who became a pampered young master. He was adopted by a childless couple, and after a year of relatively peaceful life, his foster parents miraculously had a son, plunging his life into hell. Encountering Lu Muchi was the executioner of his life. Lu Muchi couldn’t get what he wanted from his brother, so he chose him as a substitute. His foster parents saw the money, happily sold him to Lu Muchi. Under Lu Muchi’s mental and physical ab*se, he fell in love with Lu Muchi due to Stockholm Syndrome. In the end, he sacrificed his last remaining value—his eyes—for his protagonist brother and was hit by a car while trying to save another protagonist, Lu Muchi. His life ended at 21. What kind of joke is this? Yan Heqing’s has begun his hunting. His Abusing foster parents’ family. His love-brained brother who took away his eyes. And— Lu Muchi, who trampled on his dignity, destroyed his dreams, and took away his life. …… He will not let anything go. His eyes, dignity, dreams, and life, he will reclaim them all.

title: It’s My Turn to Take the Stage to Fly
description: Jiang Chen, an esports prodigy, led his team to win the championship in the first and second seasons of the Dreamscape Professional League. He should have had boundless prospects, but unfortunately, he was struck with a terminal illness and had to retire at the peak of his career. Full of unwillingness, impulsiveness, and desperation… Jiang Chen decided to gamble his life, choosing to freeze himself. Thirty years later, Evergreen Alliance’s Dreamscape took a bold step and became the world’s first holographic online game. Numerous players flared up with excitement, including those who had quit, those retired, new fans, old fans, they all flocked into the game. Awakened from his frozen state, Jiang Chen still carried an undiminished passion in his heart. He took a step forward and entered the game as well. Fang Jingxing, a popular captain of the Dreamscape Professional League, retired successfully with glory and honor, finally began his lovely retirement life. On the day the servers opened, the starving and waiting fans finally got to see their Captain Fang’s stream and crazily showered him with gifts. Fang Jingxing cooperatively drew lots and ended up drawing the “Pretend to be a newbie.” Under the watchful eyes of the viewers, he walked up to a player. Fang Jingxing: “Boss, it’s my first time playing, can you carry me?” Jiang Chen glanced at him: “Are you over ten years old?” Fang Jingxing: “I am.” Jiang Chen: “Alright, Daddy will carry you and show you how to dominate.” Fans gathered around the stream: Hah, let’s see who ends up carrying whom! Ten minutes later, Captain Fang and the fans watched collectively as he single-handedly subdued and struck the dungeon boss to the ground. Fang Jingxing raised an eyebrow: Oho. Fans: …Daddy!
